-- Evernight v2.19: self-contained installer and runner.
local source=[====[
-- Persistent preferences and teleport continuation, confined to Project Eternity.
local continuity = (function()
-- Standalone constructor. No Roblox state or disk writes occur until an API method is called.
-- Integrate before state defaults; dependencies may be injected for isolated tests.
local function createPersistentSettings(options)
    options = options or {}
    local userId = tonumber(options.UserId)
    assert(userId and userId >= 1 and userId == math.floor(userId) and userId < 9007199254740992, "Invalid settings UserId")
    local encode, decode = options.Encode, options.Decode
    if type(encode) ~= "function" or type(decode) ~= "function" then
        local service = game:GetService("HttpService")
        encode = function(value) return service:JSONEncode(value) end
        decode = function(value) return service:JSONDecode(value) end
    end
    local clockNow = options.Clock or os.clock
    local fs = options.Fs or {IsFile = isfile, ReadFile = readfile, WriteFile = writefile, MakeFolder = makefolder}
    local folder = options.Folder or "EvernightControl"
    assert(type(folder) == "string" and folder:match("^[%w_%-]+$") and #folder <= 64, "Invalid settings folder")
    local available = type(fs.IsFile) == "function" and type(fs.ReadFile) == "function" and type(fs.WriteFile) == "function"
    local api = {Available = available, Status = available and "พร้อมจำการตั้งค่า" or "ตัวรันไม่รองรับบันทึกการตั้งค่า",
        WebhookStatus = "ยังไม่ได้อ่านการตั้งค่า Discord"}
    local stopped, dirty, dueAt, lastObserved, lastSaved = false, nil, nil, nil, nil
    local lastWebhookKey = nil
    local schemaVersion = 1
    local booleanKeys = {"PersistenceEnabled", "AutoJoinWorld", "AutoResumeFarm", "Enabled", "AutoTownWarp",
        "AutoRespawn", "AntiAfk", "SkillsEnabled", "AutoPotion", "MenuVisible", "WebhookEnabled"}
    local modes = {Combat = true, Mining = true, Craft = true, Sell = true, Quest = true}
    local oreKinds = {CaveSteelFirst = true, SteelOre = true, IronOre = true, CrystalliteOre = true,
        CrystalliteArea1 = true, CrystalliteArea2 = true}
    local searches = {"Combat", "Mining", "Craft", "Sell", "Quest", "World"}

    local function finite(value)
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
    end
    local function safeText(value, maximum, allowEmpty)
        if type(value) ~= "string" or #value > maximum or (not allowEmpty and #value == 0)
            or value:find("[%z\1-\31\127]") then return nil end
        -- Credentials do not belong in public preferences, even if pasted into a search box.
        local lower = value:lower()
        if lower:find("discord.com/api/webhooks/", 1, true) or lower:find("discordapp.com/api/webhooks/", 1, true) then return nil end
        return value
    end
    local function booleanMap(value, limit, keyLength)
        if type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local result, keys = {}, {}
        for key, flag in pairs(value) do
            if type(flag) == "boolean" and safeText(key, keyLength, false) then keys[#keys + 1] = key end
        end
        table.sort(keys)
        for index = 1, math.min(#keys, limit) do result[keys[index]] = value[keys[index]] end
        return result
    end
    local function sanitize(value)
        if type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if value.PersistenceEnabled == false then return {PersistenceEnabled = false} end
        local result = {}
        for _, key in ipairs(booleanKeys) do if type(value[key]) == "boolean" then result[key] = value[key] end end
        if modes[value.Mode] then result.Mode = value.Mode end
        if oreKinds[value.SelectedOre] then result.SelectedOre = value.SelectedOre end
        for _, key in ipairs({"SelectedMob", "SelectedWeapon", "CraftMaterial"}) do
            local text = safeText(value[key], 120, false)
            if text then result[key] = text end
        end
        if finite(value.PotionThreshold) then result.PotionThreshold = math.clamp(math.floor(value.PotionThreshold), 1, 99) end
        if finite(value.CraftQuantity) then result.CraftQuantity = math.clamp(math.floor(value.CraftQuantity), 1, 99) end
        if finite(value.UiScale) then result.UiScale = math.clamp(value.UiScale, 0.65, 1.1) end
        if value.LastFloor==1 or value.LastFloor==2 then result.LastFloor=value.LastFloor end
        result.SkillSelection = booleanMap(value.SkillSelection, 256, 160)
        result.SellLocks = booleanMap(value.SellLocks, 1000, 100)
        if type(value.UiSearch) == "table" then
            result.UiSearch = {}
            for _, key in ipairs(searches) do
                local text = safeText(value.UiSearch[key], 240, true)
                if text then result.UiSearch[key] = text end
            end
        end
        -- Remember preferences for other modes, but never resume a transaction or quest.
        if result.Mode ~= "Combat" and result.Mode ~= "Mining" then result.Enabled = false end
        return result
    end
    local function validWebhook(value)
        if type(value) ~= "table" or type(value.Url) ~= "string" or #value.Url > 500 then return nil end
        local url = value.Url:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if not url:match("^https://discord%.com/api/webhooks/%d+/[%w_%-]+$")
            and not url:match("^https://discordapp%.com/api/webhooks/%d+/[%w_%-]+$") then return nil end
        return {Url = url, Enabled = value.Enabled == true}
    end
    local function canonical(value)
        local kind = type(value)
        if kind == "boolean" then return value and "true" or "false" end
        if kind == "number" then return string.format("%.17g", value) end
        if kind == "string" then return encode(value) end
        if kind ~= "table" then return "null" end
        local keys, pieces = {}, {}
        for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
        table.sort(keys)
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do pieces[#pieces + 1] = encode(key) .. ":" .. canonical(value[key]) end
        return "{" .. table.concat(pieces, ",") .. "}"
    end
    local function validateProfile(value, schema, cleaner)
        if type(value) ~= "table" or value.Schema ~= schema or value.Version ~= schemaVersion
            or value.UserId ~= userId then return nil end
        local settings = cleaner(value.Settings)
        if not settings then return nil end
        local revision = finite(value.Revision) and math.max(0, math.floor(value.Revision)) or 0
        return {Schema = schema, Version = schemaVersion, UserId = userId, Revision = revision, Settings = settings}
    end
    local function makeStore(suffix, schema, cleaner)
        local path = folder .. "/" .. tostring(userId) .. suffix
        local store = {Path = path, NeedsRepair = false, FutureVersion = false}
        local function readOne(candidate)
            local exists, found = pcall(fs.IsFile, candidate)
            if not exists or not found then return nil end
            local readOk, raw = pcall(fs.ReadFile, candidate)
            if not readOk or type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 262144 then return nil end
            local decoded, value = pcall(decode, raw)
            if not decoded then return nil end
            if type(value) == "table" and value.Schema == schema and value.UserId == userId
                and finite(value.Version) and value.Version > schemaVersion then store.FutureVersion = true end
            local profile = validateProfile(value, schema, cleaner)
            if not profile then return nil end
            return {Profile = profile, Raw = raw, Path = candidate}
        end
        function store.Load()
            if not available then return nil, "Unavailable" end
            local best
            store.FutureVersion = false
            for _, candidate in ipairs({path, path .. ".tmp", path .. ".bak"}) do
                local found = readOne(candidate)
                if found and (not best or found.Profile.Revision > best.Profile.Revision) then best = found end
            end
            if store.FutureVersion then return nil, "NewerVersion" end
            store.NeedsRepair = best ~= nil and best.Path ~= path
            return best and best.Profile or nil, best and best.Path or "Empty", best and best.Raw or nil
        end
        function store.Save(settings)
            if not available then return false, "Unavailable" end
            local clean = cleaner(settings)
            if not clean then return false, "Invalid" end
            local current, reason, previousRaw = store.Load()
            if reason == "NewerVersion" then return false, reason end
            local profile = {Schema = schema, Version = schemaVersion, UserId = userId,
                Revision = (current and current.Revision or 0) + 1, Settings = clean}
            local encoded, raw = pcall(encode, profile)
            if not encoded or type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 262144 then return false, "Encode" end
            if type(fs.MakeFolder) == "function" then pcall(fs.MakeFolder, folder) end
            local wrote = pcall(fs.WriteFile, path .. ".tmp", raw)
            local checked = wrote and readOne(path .. ".tmp")
            if not checked or canonical(checked.Profile.Settings) ~= canonical(clean) then return false, "TempVerify" end
            if previousRaw then
                local backupOk = pcall(fs.WriteFile, path .. ".bak", previousRaw)
                local backup = backupOk and readOne(path .. ".bak")
                if not backup or backup.Raw ~= previousRaw then return false, "BackupVerify" end
            end
            local committed = pcall(fs.WriteFile, path, raw)
            local final = committed and readOne(path)
            if not final or final.Raw ~= raw then return false, "CommitVerify" end
            store.NeedsRepair = false
            return true, profile
        end
        return store
    end
    local publicStore = makeStore(".settings.json", "EvernightSettings", sanitize)
    local privateStore = makeStore(".webhook.json", "EvernightWebhook", validWebhook)

    function api.Validate(value)
        return validateProfile(value, "EvernightSettings", sanitize)
    end
    function api.Capture(state)
        state = type(state) == "table" and state or {}
        local snapshot = {}
        for _, key in ipairs(booleanKeys) do snapshot[key] = state[key] end
        for _, key in ipairs({"Mode", "SelectedMob", "SelectedOre", "SelectedWeapon", "CraftMaterial",
            "CraftQuantity", "PotionThreshold", "UiScale", "UiSearch", "SkillSelection", "SellLocks", "LastFloor"}) do snapshot[key] = state[key] end
        -- A cross-floor pause must not overwrite the actual desired farm switch.
        if type(state.FloorTravelResumeEnabled) == "boolean" then snapshot.Enabled = state.FloorTravelResumeEnabled end
        return sanitize(snapshot)
    end
    function api.Load()
        local profile, reason = publicStore.Load()
        if profile then
            lastSaved = canonical(profile.Settings)
            api.Status = publicStore.NeedsRepair and "กู้การตั้งค่าจากไฟล์สำรองแล้ว" or "โหลดการตั้งค่าแล้ว"
        else
            api.Status = reason == "Unavailable" and "ตัวรันไม่รองรับบันทึกการตั้งค่า"
                or reason == "NewerVersion" and "ไฟล์ตั้งค่าเป็นรุ่นใหม่กว่า • ยังไม่เขียนทับ" or "ยังไม่มีการตั้งค่าที่บันทึก"
        end
        return profile, reason
    end
    function api.Save(settings)
        if stopped then return false, "Stopped" end
        local clean = sanitize(settings)
        if not clean then return false, "Invalid" end
        local key = canonical(clean)
        if key == lastSaved and not publicStore.NeedsRepair then
            local current=publicStore.Load()
            if current and canonical(current.Settings)==key then return true, "Unchanged" end
        end
        local ok, result = publicStore.Save(clean)
        if ok then
            lastSaved = key
            api.Status = "บันทึกการตั้งค่าแล้ว"
        else
            api.Status = result == "Unavailable" and "ตัวรันไม่รองรับบันทึกการตั้งค่า"
                or result == "NewerVersion" and "ไฟล์ตั้งค่าเป็นรุ่นใหม่กว่า • ยังไม่เขียนทับ" or "บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ • จะลองใหม่"
        end
        return ok, result
    end
    function api.CanResume(settings, mode)
        return type(settings) == "table" and settings.PersistenceEnabled ~= false and settings.AutoResumeFarm ~= false
            and settings.Enabled == true and (mode == "Combat" or mode == "Mining")
    end
    function api.LoadWebhook()
        local profile, reason = privateStore.Load()
        if profile then lastWebhookKey = canonical(profile.Settings) end
        api.WebhookStatus = profile and "โหลดการตั้งค่า Discord แล้ว" or "ยังไม่มีการตั้งค่า Discord ที่บันทึก"
        return profile and profile.Settings or nil, reason
    end
    function api.SaveWebhook(settings)
        if stopped then return false, "Stopped" end
        local clean = validWebhook(settings)
        if not clean then return false, "Invalid" end
        local key = canonical(clean)
        if key == lastWebhookKey and not privateStore.NeedsRepair then
            local current=privateStore.Load()
            if current and canonical(current.Settings)==key then return true, "Unchanged" end
        end
        local ok, reason = privateStore.Save(clean)
        if ok then lastWebhookKey = key end
        api.WebhookStatus = ok and "บันทึกการตั้งค่า Discord แล้ว" or "บันทึกการตั้งค่า Discord ไม่สำเร็จ"
        return ok, ok and "Saved" or reason
    end
    function api.Step(state)
        if stopped then return false, "Stopped" end
        local snapshot = api.Capture(state)
        local key = canonical(snapshot)
        local now = clockNow()
        if key ~= lastObserved then
            lastObserved, dirty, dueAt = key, snapshot, now + 1
        elseif publicStore.NeedsRepair and not dirty then
            dirty, dueAt = snapshot, now + 1
        end
        if dirty and now >= dueAt then
            local ok, reason = api.Save(dirty)
            if ok then dirty, dueAt = nil, nil else dueAt = now + 5 end
            return ok, reason
        end
        return true, dirty and "Pending" or "Unchanged"
    end
    function api.Stop(state)
        if stopped then return true, "Stopped" end
        local ok, reason = true, "Unchanged"
        if type(state) == "table" then ok, reason = api.Save(api.Capture(state))
        elseif dirty then ok, reason = api.Save(dirty) end
        stopped, dirty, dueAt = true, nil, nil
        return ok, reason
    end
    return api
end


    local Players=game:GetService("Players")
    local localPlayer=Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
    local globals=getgenv()
    local store=createPersistentSettings({UserId=localPlayer.UserId})
    local profile=store.Load()
    local saved=profile and profile.Settings or {}
    local api={Store=store,Saved=saved,SourcePath="EvernightControl/main.luau",QueueStatus="ยังไม่ได้เตรียมโหลดต่อ"}
    local allowed={[13725495850]=true,[108438460215241]=true,[75952228303182]=true,
        [98460737039314]=true,[13761991508]=true,[76652994877247]=true}
    api.Allowed=allowed[game.PlaceId]==true
    api.IsLanding=game.PlaceId==13725495850
    if api.Allowed then
-- Shared by landing and world; one engine idle listener and one watchdog.
do
-- Pure scheduler; the caller owns one Step worker and one Player.Idled subscription.
local function createIdleGuard(options)
    options = options or {}
    local clockNow, waitFor = options.Clock or os.clock, options.Wait or task.wait
    local function positive(value, fallback, allowZero)
        if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or value >= math.huge
            or (allowZero and value < 0 or not allowZero and value <= 0) then return fallback end
        return value
    end
    local interval = positive(options.Interval, 60, false)
    local retry = positive(options.Retry, 5, false)
    local hold = positive(options.Hold, 0.08, true)
    local minGap = positive(options.MinGap, 20, true)
    local backends = {}
    for _, backend in ipairs(type(options.Backends) == "table" and options.Backends or {}) do
        if type(backend) == "table" and type(backend.Down) == "function" and type(backend.Up) == "function" then
            backends[#backends + 1] = {Name = tostring(backend.Name or ("Backend " .. (#backends + 1))),
                Down = backend.Down, Up = backend.Up}
        end
    end
    local initial = positive(options.InitialPulses, 0, true)
    local metrics = {Attempts = 0, CompletedPairs = math.floor(initial), Failures = 0,
        Enabled = options.Enabled ~= false, Alive = true, Held = false,
        NextDue = options.Enabled ~= false and (clockNow() + interval) or nil}
    local held, busy, releasing, generation, retryNotBefore = nil, false, false, 0, 0
    local api = {}

    function api.GetStatus()
        local result = {}
        for key, value in pairs(metrics) do result[key] = value end
        result.Held, result.Enabled, result.Alive = held ~= nil, metrics.Enabled, metrics.Alive
        return result
    end
    local function publish()
        metrics.Held = held ~= nil
        if type(options.OnUpdate) == "function" then pcall(options.OnUpdate, api.GetStatus()) end
    end
    local function failure(label, problem)
        metrics.Failures = metrics.Failures + 1
        metrics.Error = label .. ": " .. tostring(problem):sub(1, 220)
        retryNotBefore = clockNow() + retry
        metrics.NextDue = retryNotBefore
    end
    local function releaseHeld()
        if not held then return true end
        if releasing then return false, "ReleaseBusy" end
        releasing = true
        local owner = held
        local ok, result = pcall(owner.Up)
        releasing = false
        if ok and result ~= false then
            if held == owner then held = nil end
            metrics.LastReleaseAt = clockNow()
            publish()
            return true
        end
        failure("Release " .. owner.Name, ok and "returned false" or result)
        publish()
        return false, "ReleaseFailed"
    end
    local function active(token)
        return metrics.Alive and metrics.Enabled and generation == token
    end
    local function finish(ok, reason)
        busy, metrics.BusySince = false, nil
        publish()
        return ok, reason
    end

    function api.OnIdle(seconds)
        metrics.LastIdleSeconds = positive(seconds, 0, true)
        metrics.LastIdledAt = clockNow()
        if metrics.Alive and metrics.Enabled then
            local earliest = math.max(clockNow(), retryNotBefore,
                metrics.LastPulse and metrics.LastPulse + minGap or -math.huge)
            metrics.NextDue = math.min(metrics.NextDue or earliest, earliest)
        end
        publish()
        return true
    end
    function api.SetEnabled(enabled)
        if not metrics.Alive then return false, "Destroyed" end
        local on = enabled == true
        if metrics.Enabled ~= on then
            local previousDue = metrics.NextDue
            metrics.Enabled, generation = on, generation + 1
            if held then
                metrics.NextDue = math.min(previousDue or clockNow(), clockNow() + retry)
            else
                retryNotBefore = 0
                metrics.NextDue = on and (clockNow() + interval) or nil
            end
        end
        local released = true
        if not on then released = releaseHeld() end
        publish()
        return released
    end
    function api.Destroy()
        metrics.Alive, metrics.Enabled = false, false
        generation = generation + 1
        metrics.NextDue = nil
        -- Always attempt cleanup, including repeated Destroy calls after a failed Up.
        local released, reason = releaseHeld()
        publish()
        return released, reason
    end

    function api.Step()
        if busy then return false, "Busy" end
        local now = clockNow()
        if held then
            if metrics.NextDue and now < metrics.NextDue then return false, "ReleaseWaiting" end
            busy, metrics.BusySince = true, now
            local released = releaseHeld()
            if released then
                retryNotBefore = 0
                metrics.NextDue = metrics.Alive and metrics.Enabled and math.max(clockNow() + retry,
                    metrics.LastPulse and metrics.LastPulse + minGap or -math.huge) or nil
            end
            -- Cleanup-only step: a new backend is never used during an owned-release retry.
            return finish(released, released and "Released" or "ReleaseFailed")
        end
        if not metrics.Alive then return false, "Destroyed" end
        if not metrics.Enabled then return false, "Disabled" end
        local earliest = math.max(metrics.NextDue or now, retryNotBefore,
            metrics.LastPulse and metrics.LastPulse + minGap or -math.huge)
        if now < earliest then return false, "Waiting" end
        busy, metrics.BusySince = true, now
        local token = generation
        if #backends == 0 then
            failure("Input", "no supported backend")
            return finish(false, "NoBackend")
        end
        for _, backend in ipairs(backends) do
            if not active(token) then return finish(false, "Cancelled") end
            -- Ownership is recorded BEFORE Down, including a partially successful throwing Down.
            held, metrics.Backend = backend, backend.Name
            metrics.Attempts = metrics.Attempts + 1
            publish()
            if not active(token) or held ~= backend then
                releaseHeld()
                return finish(false, "Cancelled")
            end
            local downOk, downResult = pcall(backend.Down)
            local downSucceeded = downOk and downResult ~= false
            if not downSucceeded then
                failure("Down " .. backend.Name, downOk and "returned false" or downResult)
                local released = releaseHeld()
                if not released then return finish(false, "ReleaseFailed") end
                if not active(token) then return finish(false, "Cancelled") end
                -- Fall through only after a failed Down has been completely released.
            else
                if not active(token) then
                    releaseHeld()
                    return finish(false, "Cancelled")
                end
                local waited, waitProblem = pcall(waitFor, hold)
                if not waited then failure("Hold " .. backend.Name, waitProblem) end
                local released = releaseHeld()
                if not released then return finish(false, "ReleaseFailed") end
                if not active(token) then return finish(false, "Cancelled") end
                if not waited then return finish(false, "HoldFailed") end
                metrics.CompletedPairs = metrics.CompletedPairs + 1
                metrics.LastPulse, metrics.Error = clockNow(), nil
                retryNotBefore = 0
                metrics.NextDue = metrics.LastPulse + interval
                return finish(true, "Completed")
            end
        end
        metrics.NextDue = math.max(clockNow() + retry, retryNotBefore)
        return finish(false, "DownFailed")
    end
    publish()
    return api
end


    local oldSession=globals.EvernightIdleSession
    if oldSession and type(oldSession.Destroy)=="function" then pcall(oldSession.Destroy) end
    local input=game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local actions=game:GetService("ContextActionService")
    local modernOk,modern=pcall(input.CreateVirtualInput,input)
    if not modernOk then modern=nil end
    local legacyOk,legacy=pcall(game.GetService,game,"VirtualInputManager")

    local session={StartedAt=os.clock(),Connections={},OtherInputs=0,LastOtherInput=-math.huge,PreferLegacy=false,EngineIdleEvents=0}
    local function safeKey()
        local before=(getthreadidentity and getthreadidentity()) or 8
        if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(2) end
        local binds
        pcall(function()
            local client=localPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Client")
            local m=client and client:FindFirstChild("Keybinds")

            if binds and type(binds.boundTo)=="function" then

                if not ok or value then bound=true end
            end
            for _,info in cas do for _,item in info.inputTypes or {} do if item==key then bound=true end end end
            if not bound then found=key break end
        end
        if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(before) end
        if not found then error("No unused function key available") end
        return found
    end
    local backends={}
    if modern then
        local heldKey

            if not ok then error(problem) end

    if legacy then
        local heldKey

            heldKey=safeKey()

        end,Up=function()
            if not heldKey then return true end

            if not ok and modern then ok,problem=pcall(modern.SendKey,modern,false,heldKey,false) end
            if not ok then error(problem) end
            heldKey=nil
            return true
        end})
    end
    local live=globals.EternityAutoFarm
    local initial=live and live.Alive and live.AntiAfkPulses or 0
    local guard=createIdleGuard({Backends=backends,Enabled=saved.AntiAfk~=false,InitialPulses=initial,
        Interval=60,Retry=5,Hold=0.08,MinGap=20})
    session.Guard,api.IdleGuard=guard,guard
    api.IdleSession=session
    function api.SyncIdle(state)
        local metrics=guard.GetStatus()
        state.AntiAfkPulses,state.AntiAfkError=metrics.CompletedPairs,metrics.Error
        state.AntiAfkLastPulse,state.AntiAfkLastIdleSeconds=metrics.LastPulse,metrics.LastIdleSeconds
        state.AntiAfkBusy=metrics.Held or metrics.BusySince~=nil
        return metrics
    end
    function session.Destroy()
        session.Stopped=true
        for _,connection in session.Connections do pcall(function()connection:Disconnect()end) end
        return guard.Destroy()
    end
    local function idle(seconds)
        session.EngineIdleEvents+=1
        session.LastEngineIdleSeconds=seconds
        local metrics=guard.GetStatus()
        if type(seconds)=="number" and seconds>=180 and metrics.LastPulse
            and os.clock()-metrics.LastPulse<90 and os.clock()-session.StartedAt>=180 then
            session.PreferLegacy=true
        end
        guard.OnIdle(seconds)
    end
    session.Connection=localPlayer.Idled:Connect(idle)
    table.insert(session.Connections,session.Connection)
    local function otherInput(object)
        local key=object.KeyCode
        if key~=Enum.KeyCode.F15 and key~=Enum.KeyCode.F14 and key~=Enum.KeyCode.F13 then
            session.OtherInputs+=1
            session.LastOtherInput=os.clock()
        end
    end
    table.insert(session.Connections,input.InputBegan:Connect(otherInput))
    table.insert(session.Connections,input.InputChanged:Connect(function(object)
        if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and object.Delta.Magnitude>0 then otherInput(object) end
    end))
    session.Worker=task.spawn(function()
        while not session.Stopped or guard.GetStatus().Held do
            if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(8) end
            local previousHeld=oldSession and oldSession.Guard and oldSession.Guard.GetStatus().Held
            if previousHeld then pcall(oldSession.Guard.Step)
            else
                local metrics=guard.GetStatus()
                if metrics.Held or os.clock()-session.LastOtherInput>=45 then pcall(guard.Step) end
            end
            local state=api.WorldState or globals.EvernightLanding
            if state and state.Alive then api.SyncIdle(state) end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
    globals.EvernightIdleSession=session
end

end
    function api.Apply(settings)
        if saved.PersistenceEnabled~=false then
            for key,value in saved do if settings[key]==nil then settings[key]=value end end
            if settings.Webhook==nil then settings.Webhook=store.LoadWebhook() end
        elseif settings.PersistenceEnabled==nil then settings.PersistenceEnabled=false end
        return settings
    end
    function api.Queue()
        if globals.EvernightContinuationQueued then api.QueueStatus="พร้อมโหลดต่อหลังย้ายชั้น";return true end
        local queue=queue_on_teleport or queueonteleport or (syn and syn.queue_on_teleport)
        if type(queue)~="function" or type(isfile)~="function" or not isfile(api.SourcePath) then
            api.QueueStatus="ต้องรันสคริปต์ใหม่หลังย้ายชั้น";return false
        end
        local ok=pcall(queue,[=[
            task.spawn(function()
                if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
                local allowed={[13725495850]=true,[108438460215241]=true,[75952228303182]=true,
                    [98460737039314]=true,[13761991508]=true,[76652994877247]=true}
                if not allowed[game.PlaceId] or getgenv().EvernightContinuationBooted then return end
                getgenv().EvernightContinuationBooted=true
                local ok,problem=pcall(function()
                    local source=readfile("EvernightControl/main.luau")
                    local chunk,why=loadstring(source)
                    if not chunk then error(why) end
                    chunk()
                end)
                if not ok then getgenv().EvernightContinuationError=tostring(problem) end
            end)
        ]=])
        if ok then globals.EvernightContinuationQueued=true end
        api.QueueStatus=ok and "พร้อมโหลดต่อหลังย้ายชั้น" or "เตรียมโหลดต่อไม่สำเร็จ"
        return ok
    end
    function api.Save(state,immediate)
        local ok,why
        if immediate then ok,why=store.Save(store.Capture(state)) else ok,why=store.Step(state) end
        state.PersistenceStatus=store.Status
        if state.PersistenceEnabled~=false and type(state.GetWebhookSettings)=="function" then
            local got,settings=pcall(state.GetWebhookSettings)
            if got and settings and settings.Url then store.SaveWebhook(settings) end
        end
        return ok,why
    end
    function api.Stop(state)
        api.Save(state,true)
        return store.Stop(state)
    end
    function api.StartLanding()
        -- Preparation only: nativeLandingStep does not continue, select a slot, or teleport.
-- The caller explicitly invokes the returned Action under normal script identity.
-- Sources: SAOMainMenu.Controller.Get/Continue, Bridge.startGame/quickJoin,
-- ReplicatedStorage.Client.teleportToFloor. All instance paths are native.
local function nativeLandingStep(preferredFloor)
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local function result(phase, reason, details)
        local value = details or {}
        value.Phase = phase
        value.Reason = reason
        value.Ready = value.Action ~= nil
        return value
    end

    if game.PlaceId ~= 13725495850 then
        return result("not_landing", "The native landing menu is not active in this place.")
    end
    local requested = preferredFloor ~= nil and tonumber(preferredFloor) or nil
    if preferredFloor ~= nil and requested ~= 1 and requested ~= 2 then
        return result("invalid_floor", "Choose Floor 1 or Floor 2.")
    end

    local playerGui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local gui = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("SAOMainMenu")
    local controllerModule = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Controller")
    local client = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Client")
    local storeModule = client and client:FindFirstChild("Store")
    local teleportModule = client and client:FindFirstChild("teleportToFloor")
    if not gui or not controllerModule or not storeModule or not teleportModule then
        return result("loading", "Waiting for the native landing modules.")
    end
    if not gui.Enabled then
        return result("loading", "Waiting for the native landing menu to become visible.")
    end

    local controllerOk, controllerLibrary = pcall(require, controllerModule)
    if not controllerOk or type(controllerLibrary) ~= "table" or type(controllerLibrary.Get) ~= "function" then
        return result("loading", "The native landing controller is not available.")
    end
    local controller = controllerLibrary.Get(gui)
    if not controller or type(controller.GetState) ~= "function" or type(controller.GetCharacter) ~= "function"
        or type(controller.Continue) ~= "function" then
        return result("loading", "Waiting for the existing native menu controller.")
    end

    local function readExisting()
        local view = controller.GetState()
        if type(view) ~= "table" or type(view.Slot) ~= "number" then
            return nil, nil, "Waiting for the current character slot."
        end
        local character = controller.GetCharacter(view.Slot)
        if type(character) ~= "table" then
            return view, nil, "The selected character slot is not available."
        end
        if character.Locked then
            return view, nil, "The selected character slot is locked."
        end
        if character.Status ~= "ready" then
            return view, nil, "The selected character slot is not ready: " .. tostring(character.Status or "loading") .. "."
        end
        if type(character.Look) ~= "table" then
            return view, nil, "The selected slot has no existing character."
        end
        local characters = gui:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        local slotObject = characters and characters:FindFirstChild("Slot" .. tostring(view.Slot))
        if slotObject then
            local occupiedValue = slotObject:FindFirstChild("Occupied")
            if slotObject:GetAttribute("Occupied") == false
                or (occupiedValue and occupiedValue:IsA("BoolValue") and not occupiedValue.Value) then
                return view, nil, "The selected slot is empty; character creation requires manual input."
            end
        end
        return view, character
    end

    local view, character, characterReason = readExisting()
    if not character then
        return result("character_unavailable", characterReason, {Slot = view and view.Slot})
    end
    local slot = view.Slot
    if view.Busy then
        return result("busy", "The native landing menu is changing screens.", {Slot = slot})
    end
    if view.Page == "Customize" or view.EditingSlot ~= nil then
        return result("manual_customization", "Finish or cancel customization manually before entering the world.", {Slot = slot})
    end

    local function loadedData()
        local storeOk, store = pcall(require, storeModule)
        if not storeOk or type(store) ~= "table" or type(store.getState) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        local data = store:getState().playerData
        if player:GetAttribute("SelectedSlot") ~= slot or type(data) ~= "table"
            or not data.appearance or not data.progression then
            return nil
        end
        return data
    end

    if view.Modal == "ServerSelection" then
        local data = loadedData()
        if not data then
            return result("loading_slot", "Waiting for the selected character save to finish loading.", {Slot = slot})
        end
        if data.progression.freshSlot then
            return result("manual_customization", "This save still requires character setup; automatic entry is paused.", {Slot = slot})
        end
        local floor = requested or tonumber(data.floors and data.floors.last) or 1
        if floor ~= 1 and floor ~= 2 then
            return result("invalid_floor", "The saved floor is not available in the native landing menu.", {Slot = slot})
        end
        if slot == 4 and floor ~= 1 then
            return result("floor_locked", "The native menu limits the Perma Death slot to Floor 1.", {Slot = slot, Floor = floor})
        end
        local highest = tonumber(data.floors and data.floors.highest)
        if highest and floor > highest then
            return result("floor_locked", "This character has not unlocked the requested floor.", {Slot = slot, Floor = floor})
        end
        local teleportOk, nativeTeleportToFloor = pcall(require, teleportModule)
        if not teleportOk or type(nativeTeleportToFloor) ~= "function" then
            return result("loading", "The native quick join function is not available.", {Slot = slot, Floor = floor})
        end
        return result("join", "The existing character is ready for native quick join.", {
            Slot = slot,
            Floor = floor,
            ActionKind = "quick_join",
            Action = function()
                local current, existing = readExisting()
                local currentData = loadedData()
                if not gui.Parent or not gui.Enabled or not existing or current.Slot ~= slot
                    or current.Busy or current.Modal ~= "ServerSelection" or current.Page == "Customize"
                    or not currentData or currentData.progression.freshSlot then
                    return false, "The native landing state changed before quick join."
                end
                return nativeTeleportToFloor(floor)
            end,
        })
    end

    if view.Modal ~= nil then
        return result("modal_open", "Close the current native menu dialog before entering the world.", {Slot = slot})
    end
    if view.Page ~= "Home" and view.Page ~= "Slots" then
        return result("not_home", "Return to the native Home or Slots screen before entering the world.", {Slot = slot})
    end
    local data = loadedData()
    if data and data.progression.freshSlot then
        return result("manual_customization", "This save still requires character setup; automatic entry is paused.", {Slot = slot})
    end
    return result("continue", "The selected slot contains an existing character.", {
        Slot = slot,
        ActionKind = "continue",
        Action = function()
            local current, existing = readExisting()
            local currentData = loadedData()
            if not gui.Parent or not gui.Enabled or not existing or current.Slot ~= slot or current.Busy
                or current.Modal ~= nil or current.EditingSlot ~= nil
                or (current.Page ~= "Home" and current.Page ~= "Slots")
                or (currentData and currentData.progression.freshSlot) then
                return false, "The selected existing character is no longer ready to continue."
            end
            controller.Continue()
            return true
        end,
    })
end

        label("EVERNIGHT  /  เข้าโลกอัตโนมัติ",12,7,296,22,12,Color3.fromRGB(246,155,188)).Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        local status=label("",12,31,296,34,11,Color3.fromRGB(211,203,247))
        label("ใช้ตัวละครเดิมที่เลือกไว้",12,74,204,18,10,Color3.fromRGB(167,148,182))
        local toggle=Instance.new("TextButton")
        toggle.Name,toggle.Position,toggle.Size="ToggleAutoJoin",UDim2.fromOffset(226,72),UDim2.fromOffset(82,24)
        toggle.BackgroundColor3,toggle.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(77,29,57),Color3.fromRGB(245,236,248)
        toggle.BorderSizePixel,toggle.Font,toggle.TextSize=0,Enum.Font.Gotham,11
        toggle.Parent=card
        local buttonCorner=Instance.new("UICorner") buttonCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6) buttonCorner.Parent=toggle
        local sent={}
        local startedAt=os.clock()
        local nextActionAt=0
        local phaseText={loading="รอเมนูเกมโหลด",character_unavailable="รอตัวละครเดิมพร้อมใช้งาน",
            busy="กำลังโหลดข้อมูลตัวละคร",manual_customization="กรุณาตั้งค่าตัวละครในเกมให้เสร็จก่อน",
            loading_slot="กำลังโหลดข้อมูลตัวละคร",invalid_floor="ชั้นที่เลือกยังใช้ไม่ได้",floor_locked="ตัวละครยังไปชั้นนี้ไม่ได้",
            join="ตัวละครพร้อม • กำลังเข้าโลก",continue="กำลังเลือกตัวละครเดิม",modal_open="รอหน้าต่างเกมปิด",
            not_home="รอกลับหน้าเลือกตัวละคร",not_landing="รอหน้าเข้าโลก"}
        toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
            state.AutoJoinWorld=not state.AutoJoinWorld
            local preferences=table.clone(saved)
            preferences.AutoJoinWorld=state.AutoJoinWorld
            if preferences.PersistenceEnabled~=false then store.Save(preferences) end
            if state.AutoJoinWorld then sent={} startedAt=os.clock() end
        end)
        table.insert(state.Connections,localPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(function(phase)
            if phase==Enum.TeleportState.Started or phase==Enum.TeleportState.InProgress or phase==Enum.TeleportState.WaitingForServer then
                state.TeleportStarted=true
                state.Status="กำลังเข้าโลก • รอเกมโหลด"
                api.Queue()
            end
        end))
        table.insert(state.Connections,game:GetService("TeleportService").TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(who)
            if who==localPlayer then
                state.TeleportStarted=false
                state.Status="เข้าโลกไม่สำเร็จ • จะลองใหม่"
                if state.Actions<3 then sent={} startedAt=os.clock()+3 end
            end
        end))
        task.spawn(function()
            while state.Alive and gui.Parent do
                if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(8) end
                if not state.AutoJoinWorld then state.Status="ปิดเข้าโลกอัตโนมัติ"
                elseif not state.TeleportStarted then
                    local previous=(getthreadidentity and getthreadidentity()) or 8
                    if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(2) end
                    local ok,probe=pcall(nativeLandingStep,saved.LastFloor)
                    if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(previous) end
                    if not ok then state.Status="รอข้อมูลหน้าเข้าโลก" state.Error=tostring(probe)
                    else
                        state.Phase=probe.Phase
                        state.Status=phaseText[probe.Phase] or "กำลังรอข้อมูล"
                        state.Reason=probe.Reason
                        local key=tostring(probe.Phase)..":"..tostring(probe.Slot)..":"..tostring(probe.Floor)
                        if os.clock()-startedAt<3 then state.Status="เข้าโลกอัตโนมัติใน "..math.max(1,math.ceil(3-os.clock()+startedAt)).." วินาที" end
                        if probe.Action and not sent[key] and state.Actions<6 and os.clock()-startedAt>=3 and os.clock()>=nextActionAt then
                            sent[key],state.Actions=true,state.Actions+1
                            if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(2) end
                            local acted,accepted,problem=pcall(probe.Action)
                            if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(previous) end
                            if not acted or accepted==false then
                                sent[key]=nil nextActionAt=os.clock()+3
                                state.Error=tostring(not acted and accepted or problem)
                                state.Status="รอข้อมูลใหม่ก่อนเข้าโลก"
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(8) end
                status.Text=state.Status
                toggle.Text=state.AutoJoinWorld and "ปิดออโต้" or "เปิดออโต้"

            end
        end)
        return state
    end

local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(function(...)
        local setIdentity = setthreadidentity or setidentity
        local getIdentity = getthreadidentity or getidentity
        local previous = getIdentity and getIdentity()
        if setIdentity then setIdentity(8) end
        local ok, problem = pcall(fn, ...)
        if previous and setIdentity then setIdentity(previous) end
        if not ok then state.LastUiError = tostring(problem) end
    end)
    table.insert(state.Connections, c)
    return c
end

local function character()
    local c = player.Character
    local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if c and h and r and h.Health > 0 then return c, h, r end
end

local function mobName(m)
    return m:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or m:GetAttribute("MobKind") or m:GetAttribute("OreType") or m.Name
end

local function mobRoot(m)
    if m and m:IsA("BasePart") then return m end
    if m and m:IsA("Model") then
        if m:GetAttribute("OreType") then
            local center = m:GetAttribute("OreCenter")
            local ore = m:FindFirstChild("Ore")
            if typeof(center) == "Vector3" then return {Position = center} end
            if ore and ore:IsA("Model") then return {Position = ore:GetPivot().Position} end
            if ore and ore:IsA("BasePart") then return ore end
        end
        return m.PrimaryPart or m:FindFirstChild("Collider")
    end
end

local steelCaveFloor = Vector3.new(-2871.73, 192.34, -2902.88)

-- Accept only real, tagged nodes in the observed mining areas of the current floor.
-- Floor 1 retains the user's strict Steel/Iron cave boundary.
local function isCaveOre(m)
    if not m or not m.Parent then return false end
    local kind = m:GetAttribute("OreType")
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("OreNodes")
    local center = mobRoot(m)
    if not folder or not center then return false end
    if currentFloor == 2 then
        return kind == "CrystalliteOre"
            and (m.Parent == folder:FindFirstChild("Area1") or m.Parent == folder:FindFirstChild("Area2"))
            and game:GetService("CollectionService"):HasTag(m, "OreNode")
            and center.Position.Y > 2000
    end
    if currentFloor ~= 1 or (kind ~= "SteelOre" and kind ~= "IronOre") then return false end
    local area = folder:FindFirstChild("Area1")
    return m.Parent == area and center.Position.Y >= 170 and center.Position.Y <= 220
        and (center.Position - steelCaveFloor).Magnitude <= 80
end

local function isSelectedOre(m)
    if not isCaveOre(m) then return false end
    if currentFloor == 2 then
        if state.Selected == "CrystalliteArea1" then return m.Parent.Name == "Area1" end
        if state.Selected == "CrystalliteArea2" then return m.Parent.Name == "Area2" end
        return state.Selected == "CrystalliteOre"
    end
    return state.Selected == "CaveSteelFirst" or m:GetAttribute("OreType") == state.Selected
end

local function oreChoiceName(name)
    if name == "m_forge" then return "Hold the Forge" end
    if name == "CaveSteelFirst" then return "Steel ก่อน → Iron (ในถ้ำ)" end
    if name == "SteelOre" then return "Steel (ในถ้ำ)" end
    if name == "IronOre" then return "Iron (ในถ้ำ)" end
    if name == "CrystalliteOre" then return "Crystallite · ใกล้ที่สุด" end
    if name == "CrystalliteArea1" then return "Crystallite · เขต Frosthaven" end
    if name == "CrystalliteArea2" then return "Crystallite · เขต Skalvik" end
    return name
end

local function valid(m)
    if state.Mode == "Quest" then return forgeQuest and forgeQuest.IsTarget(m) or false end
    if state.Mode == "Mining" then
        return isSelectedOre(m)
            and game:GetService("CollectionService"):HasTag(m, "OreNode")
            and m:GetAttribute("MinedOut") ~= true and m:FindFirstChild("Ore") ~= nil
            and mobRoot(m) ~= nil
    end
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Mobs")
    return m and m.Parent == folder and mobName(m) == state.Selected
        and not m:GetAttribute("IsDead") and (m:GetAttribute("Health") or 0) > 0
        and mobRoot(m) ~= nil
end

-- One frame-driven motion writer; smooth body turns never change walking speed or position.
local motionController = {}
do
    local heldHumanoid, savedRotate
    local nativeHeld = false
    function motionController.Release()
        if nativeHeld and combat and combat.HoldMovementFacing then
            local ok,problem=pcall(combat.HoldMovementFacing,false)
            if not ok then state.LastMotionError=tostring(problem) end
        end
        nativeHeld=false
        state.MotionFacingOwned=false
        if heldHumanoid and heldHumanoid.Parent then
            pcall(function()heldHumanoid.AutoRotate=savedRotate end)
        end
        heldHumanoid,savedRotate=nil,nil
    end
    local function claim(h)
        if heldHumanoid~=h then
            motionController.Release()
            heldHumanoid,savedRotate=h,h.AutoRotate
        end
        if combat and combat.HoldMovementFacing then
            local ok,result=pcall(combat.HoldMovementFacing,true)
            nativeHeld=ok and result~=false
            if not ok then state.LastMotionError=tostring(result) end
        end
        state.MotionFacingOwned=nativeHeld
        h.AutoRotate=not nativeHeld
    end
    function motionController.Step(dt,focused)
        local active=state.Alive and (state.Enabled or state.Travelling)
        local _,h,root=character()
        local blocked=state.Respawning or state.StaminaRecovering
            or (potionController and potionController.Pending)
            or (autoSkills and autoSkills.Busy())
        if not active or not h or not root or h.Health<=0 or blocked or (focused and not state.Travelling) then
            if h and (active or heldHumanoid==h) then h:Move(Vector3.zero,false) end
            motionController.Release()
            return
        end
        local direction=moveGoal and Vector3.new(moveGoal.X-root.Position.X,0,moveGoal.Z-root.Position.Z)
        if direction and direction.Magnitude>.35 then
            claim(h)
            h:Move(direction.Unit,false)
            if nativeHeld then
                local desired=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,root.Position+direction.Unit)
                local alpha=1-math.exp(-16*math.clamp(tonumber(dt) or 1/60,0,.15))
                -- Both poses have the same position. Only yaw is blended.
                root.CFrame=root.CFrame:Lerp(desired,alpha)
            end
            return
        end
        h:Move(Vector3.zero,false)
        local target=state.Enabled and not state.Travelling and moveGoal==nil and valid(state.Target) and mobRoot(state.Target)
        if target then
            local aim=target.Position-root.Position
            local vertical=math.abs(aim.Y)
            aim=Vector3.new(aim.X,0,aim.Z)
            local reach=state.Mode=="Mining" and 7.1 or 7.5
            if aim.Magnitude<=reach and vertical<=7 then
                claim(h)
                -- Use the same horizontal/vertical reach as the actual engagement.
                if aim.Magnitude>.1 then root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,root.Position+aim) end
                return
            end
        end
        motionController.Release()
    end
end

local function invalidateRoute()
    generation += 1
    route, routeGoal, routeTarget = nil, nil, nil
    routeIndex, planning, lastPlan = 1, false, -100
    routePartial = false
    moveGoal = nil
    avoidanceGoal, avoidanceUntil = nil, nil
end

local function remember(c, h)
    if not originals[h] then
        originals[h] = {AutoRotate = h.AutoRotate, Sprinting = c:GetAttribute("Sprinting") == true}
    end
end

local function stopMovement()
    moveGoal = nil
    local _, h, r = character()
    if h and r then h:MoveTo(r.Position) h:Move(Vector3.zero) end
end

local function requestJump(h)
    if h.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air or os.clock() - lastJump < 0.85 then return false end
    lastJump = os.clock()
    h.Jump = true
    h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    return true
end

local function resolveCombat()
    local client = player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Client")
    local systems = client and client:FindFirstChild("Systems")
    local scriptObject = systems and systems:FindFirstChild("Combat")
    local attack
    for _, fn in filtergc("function", {Name = "lightAttack"}, false) do
        local ok, scope = pcall(getfenv, fn)
        if ok and scope.script == scriptObject then attack = fn break end
    end
    assert(attack, "ไม่พบ lightAttack ของเกม ลองใหม่หลังตัวละครโหลดเสร็จ")
    local controller
    for _, candidate in filtergc("table", {Keys = {"toggleSheathe", "setSprinting", "stopSprint", "isSheathing"}}, false) do
        if typeof(candidate.toggleSheathe) == "function" and string.find(debug.info(candidate.toggleSheathe, "s"), "CharacterController", 1, true) then
            controller = candidate
            break
        end
    end
    assert(controller, "ไม่พบ CharacterController ของเกม")
    local movementFacing = controller.holdFacing
    assert(type(movementFacing) == "function", "ไม่พบคำสั่งควบคุมทิศตัวละครของเกม")
    local scopeOk, facingScope = pcall(getfenv, movementFacing)
    local expectedController = systems and systems:FindFirstChild("CharacterController")
    assert(scopeOk and facingScope.script == expectedController,
        "คำสั่งควบคุมทิศตัวละครไม่ใช่ CharacterController ปัจจุบัน")
    -- Native holdFacing(tag, boolean) uses dot calls, not a self parameter.
    local signatureOk, parameterCount, variadic = pcall(debug.info, movementFacing, "a")
    assert(not signatureOk or (parameterCount == 2 and not variadic),
        "รูปแบบคำสั่งควบคุมทิศตัวละครของเกมเปลี่ยนไป")
    local facingIntent = {Character = nil, On = nil, RefreshedAt = -100}
    local gameInput = require(client.Input)
    local nativeCombat = require(scriptObject)
    return {
        Attack = nativeCombat.lightDown,
        Release = nativeCombat.lightUp,
        IsFocused = gameInput.isFocused,
        HoldMovementFacing = function(on)
            on = on == true
            local character, now = player.Character, os.clock()
            if facingIntent.Character == character and facingIntent.On == on
                and (not on or now - facingIntent.RefreshedAt < 0.75) then return end
            -- Unique key cannot release native Swing/Mining/skill facing holds.
            -- Native holds expire after six seconds without refresh, including on script failure.
            movementFacing("EvernightAutoFacing", on)
            facingIntent.Character, facingIntent.On, facingIntent.RefreshedAt = character, on, now
        end,
        Unsheathe = function()
            local c = player.Character
            if c and c:GetAttribute("Sheathed") and not controller.isSheathing() then
                controller.toggleSheathe()
            end
        end,
        Sprint = function(on)
            local setIdentity = setthreadidentity or setidentity
            local getIdentity = getthreadidentity or getidentity
            local previous = getIdentity and getIdentity()
            if setIdentity then setIdentity(2) end
            local ok, problem = pcall(function()
                local c = player.Character
                if not on then
                    controller.stopSprint()
                    -- The native cache can disagree with the replicated sprint state.
                    if c and c:GetAttribute("Sprinting") == true then
                        local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes:FindFirstChild("Sprint")
                        if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then remote:FireServer(false) end
                    end
                else
                    if c and c:GetAttribute("Sprinting") ~= true then controller.stopSprint() end
                    controller.setSprinting(true)
                end
            end)
            if previous and setIdentity then setIdentity(previous) end
            if not ok then error(problem) end
        end,
    }
end

-- Caller runs action methods asynchronously at thread identity 2.
local function resolveMining()
    local client = player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Client")
    local systems = client and client:FindFirstChild("Systems")
    local miningScript = systems and systems:FindFirstChild("Mining")
    local controllerScript = systems and systems:FindFirstChild("CharacterController")
    local stateScript = client and client:FindFirstChild("State")
    assert(miningScript and controllerScript and stateScript, "ระบบขุดแร่ของเกมยังโหลดไม่เสร็จ")

    local function fromScript(fn, object)
        if typeof(fn) ~= "function" then return false end
        local ok, scope = pcall(getfenv, fn)
        return ok and scope.script == object
    end

    local gameState, mining, controller, swing, findOre
    for _, candidate in filtergc("table", {Keys = {"get", "getEquipped", "equippedSlot", "findItem", "count"}}, false) do
        if fromScript(candidate.get, stateScript) then gameState = candidate break end
    end
    for _, candidate in filtergc("table", {Keys = {"down", "up", "handles", "isSwinging", "cancel"}}, false) do
        if fromScript(candidate.down, miningScript) then mining = candidate break end
    end
    for _, candidate in filtergc("table", {Keys = {"toggleSheathe", "setSprinting", "stopSprint", "isSheathing"}}, false) do
        if fromScript(candidate.toggleSheathe, controllerScript)
            and string.find(debug.info(candidate.toggleSheathe, "s"), "CharacterController", 1, true) then
            controller = candidate
            break
        end
    end
    for _, fn in filtergc("function", {Name = "swing"}, false) do
        if fromScript(fn, miningScript) then swing = fn break end
    end
    for _, fn in filtergc("function", {Name = "findOre"}, false) do
        if fromScript(fn, miningScript) then findOre = fn break end
    end
    assert(gameState, "ไม่พบข้อมูลกระเป๋าของเกม")
    assert(mining and swing and findOre, "ไม่พบคำสั่งขุดแร่ปกติของเกม")
    assert(controller, "ไม่พบคำสั่งถือพลั่วของเกม")

    local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local equip = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("EquipItem")
    local unequip = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("UnequipItem")
    assert(equip and equip:IsA("RemoteEvent") and unequip and unequip:IsA("RemoteEvent"), "ไม่พบคำสั่งสวมอุปกรณ์ของเกม")

    local pickaxeTiers = {IronPickaxe = 1, CrystallitePickaxe = 2, ObsidianPickaxe = 3, VerditePickaxe = 4}
    local oreTiers = {IronOre = 1, SteelOre = 1, KoboldOre = 1, CrystalliteOre = 2, ObsidianOre = 3, VerditeOre = 4}
    local api = {}

    local function currentEquipment()
        local data = gameState.get()
        return data and data.equipment or {}
    end

    function api.Pickaxe()
        local data = gameState.get()
        local best, tier = nil, 0
        local equippedId = data and data.equipment and data.equipment.pickaxe
        for _, item in data and data.inventory or {} do
            local itemTier = pickaxeTiers[item.kind]
            if item.uniqueId and itemTier and (itemTier > tier or (itemTier == tier and item.uniqueId == equippedId)) then
                best, tier = item, itemTier
            end
        end
        return best, tier
    end

    function api.RequiredTier(ore)
        local kind = typeof(ore) == "Instance" and ore:GetAttribute("OreType") or ore
        if kind == "CaveSteelFirst" then return 1 end
        if kind == "CrystalliteArea1" or kind == "CrystalliteArea2" then return 2 end
        return oreTiers[kind] or math.huge
    end

    function api.Count(kind)
        if kind == "CaveSteelFirst" then return gameState.count("SteelIngot") + gameState.count("IronIngot") end
        local drops = {IronOre = "IronIngot", SteelOre = "SteelIngot", KoboldOre = "KoboldBar",
            CrystalliteOre = "Crystallite", ObsidianOre = "Obsidian", VerditeOre = "Verdite"}
        if kind == "CrystalliteArea1" or kind == "CrystalliteArea2" then kind = "CrystalliteOre" end
        return gameState.count(drops[kind] or kind)
    end

    function api.Currency()
        local data = gameState.get()
        return data and data.col or 0
    end

    function api.WarpTown(id)
        local remote = remotes:FindFirstChild("Teleport")
        assert(remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent"), "ไม่พบจุดวาร์ปของเกม")
        remote:FireServer(id)
    end

    function api.SaveEquipment()
        local current = currentEquipment()
        return {weapon = current.weapon, weapon2 = current.weapon2, pickaxe = current.pickaxe}
    end

    function api.EquipmentRestored(saved)
        local current = currentEquipment()
        return current.weapon == saved.weapon and current.weapon2 == saved.weapon2 and current.pickaxe == saved.pickaxe
    end

    function api.Equipped()
        local character = player.Character
        local best = api.Pickaxe()
        return best ~= nil and currentEquipment().pickaxe == best.uniqueId and character ~= nil
            and character:GetAttribute("WeaponType") == nil and character:GetAttribute("Tool") == "Pickaxe"
    end

    function api.Ready()
        return api.Equipped() and player.Character:GetAttribute("ToolDrawn") == true
    end

    function api.Equip()
        local item, tier = api.Pickaxe()
        if not item then return false, "ยังไม่มีพลั่วในกระเป๋า" end
        local current = currentEquipment()
        if current.weapon2 then unequip:FireServer("weapon2") end
        if current.weapon then unequip:FireServer("weapon") end
        if current.pickaxe ~= item.uniqueId then equip:FireServer(item.uniqueId) end
        return true, item, tier
    end

    function api.Draw()
        if not api.Equipped() then return false end
        if not api.Ready() and not controller.isSheathing() then controller.toggleSheathe() end
        return api.Ready()
    end

    function api.Cancel()
        mining.up()
        mining.cancel()
    end

    function api.Restore(saved)
        api.Cancel()
        if type(saved) ~= "table" then return end
        local current = currentEquipment()
        if saved.pickaxe then
            if current.pickaxe ~= saved.pickaxe and gameState.findItem(saved.pickaxe) then
                equip:FireServer(saved.pickaxe)
            end
        elseif current.pickaxe then
            unequip:FireServer("pickaxe")
        end
        if saved.weapon then
            if current.weapon ~= saved.weapon and gameState.findItem(saved.weapon) then
                equip:FireServer(saved.weapon)
            end
        elseif current.weapon then
            unequip:FireServer("weapon")
        end
        if saved.weapon2 then
            if current.weapon2 ~= saved.weapon2 and gameState.findItem(saved.weapon2) then
                equip:FireServer(saved.weapon2, "weapon2")
            end
        elseif current.weapon2 then
            unequip:FireServer("weapon2")
        end
    end

    function api.FindOre()
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end
        return findOre()
    end

    function api.IsSwinging()
        return mining.isSwinging()
    end

    function api.Swing(target)
        if not api.Ready() or api.IsSwinging() or not target or api.FindOre() ~= target then return false end
        swing()
        return mining.isSwinging()
    end

    return api
end

local function resolveCrafting()
    local shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
    local rules = require(shared.Blacksmith)
    local database = require(shared.ItemDatabase)
    local stateScript = player.PlayerScripts.Client.State
    local store
    for _, candidate in filtergc("table", {Keys = {"get", "getEquipped", "equippedSlot", "findItem", "count"}}, false) do
        local ok, scope = pcall(getfenv, candidate.get)
        if ok and scope.script == stateScript then store = candidate break end
    end
    assert(store, "ไม่พบข้อมูลวัตถุดิบของเกม")
    local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes:FindFirstChild("BlacksmithCraft")
    assert(remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction"), "ไม่พบระบบคราฟอาวุธของเกม")
    local api = {Types = table.clone(rules.WEAPON_TYPES), Materials = table.clone(rules.FORGE_MATERIALS)}

    function api.TypeLabel(kind) return rules.typeLabel(kind) end
    function api.MaterialLabel(kind)
        local desc = database.getDescription(kind)
        return desc and desc.name or kind
    end
    function api.ForgeDistance()
        local c = player.Character
        local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return math.huge end
        local best = math.huge
        for _, prompt in workspace:QueryDescendants("ProximityPrompt[$Kind=Blacksmith]") do
            local parent = prompt.Parent
            local point = parent:IsA("Attachment") and parent.WorldPosition or parent:IsA("BasePart") and parent.Position
            if prompt.Enabled and point then best = math.min(best, (point - root.Position).Magnitude) end
        end
        return best
    end
    function api.Preview(kind, material, quantity)
        quantity = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(quantity) or 1), 1, 99)
        if not table.find(api.Types, kind) or not table.find(api.Materials, material) then
            return {Ready = false, Reason = "เลือกชนิดอาวุธและวัสดุให้ถูกต้อง", Max = 0}
        end
        local data = store.get() or {}
        local progress = data.progression and data.progression.blacksmithing
        local smithLevel = progress and progress.level or 1
        local desc = database.getDescription(material) or {}
        local materials = table.create(rules.MATERIAL_SLOTS, material)
        local damage, speed, weaponLevel, cost, strength, agility = rules.weaponInfo(smithLevel, kind, materials)
        cost = tonumber(cost) or 0
        local have, col = store.count(material), data.col or 0
        local allowed = rules.isCraftMaterial(material, smithLevel)
        local maximum = allowed and cost > 0 and math.min(99, math.floor(have / rules.MATERIAL_SLOTS)) or 0
        local need, total = rules.MATERIAL_SLOTS * quantity, cost * quantity
        local forgeDistance = api.ForgeDistance()
        local reason = "พร้อมคราฟ • ช่าง Lv." .. smithLevel
        if not allowed then reason = "ต้องใช้ช่าง Lv." .. tostring(desc.level or 1) .. " • ตอนนี้ Lv." .. smithLevel
        elseif have < need then reason = "วัตถุดิบไม่พอ • ขาด " .. tostring(need - have)
        elseif cost <= 0 then reason = "ไม่พบสูตรอาวุธนี้"
        elseif forgeDistance > 8 then
            reason = forgeDistance == math.huge and "ไม่พบเตาหลอมในพื้นที่" or "เข้าใกล้เตาหลอมก่อน • ห่าง " .. math.floor(forgeDistance) .. " studs"
        end
        return {Ready = allowed and maximum >= quantity and forgeDistance <= 8, CanTravel = allowed and maximum >= quantity,
            Reason = reason, Max = maximum, ForgeDistance = forgeDistance,
            Name = api.MaterialLabel(material):gsub(" Ingot$", "") .. " " .. api.TypeLabel(kind),
            Material = material, WeaponType = kind, Quantity = quantity, Need = need, Have = have, Value = total, UnitValue = cost,
            Col = col, SmithLevel = smithLevel, RequiredSmithLevel = desc.level or 1,
            Damage = damage, Speed = speed, WeaponLevel = weaponLevel, Strength = strength, Agility = agility,
            Materials = materials}
    end
    function api.CraftOnce(kind, material)
        local preview = api.Preview(kind, material, 1)
        if not preview.Ready then return {ok = false, message = preview.Reason}, preview end
        preview.BeforeIds = {}
        for _, item in (store.get() or {}).inventory or {} do
            if item.uniqueId then preview.BeforeIds[item.uniqueId] = true end
        end
        -- Same argument order and empty default name used by the game's Blacksmith UI.
        return remote:InvokeServer("", kind, preview.Materials, nil), preview
    end
    function api.Settled(preview)
        local data = store.get() or {}
        if store.count(preview.Material) > preview.Have - rules.MATERIAL_SLOTS then return false end
        for _, item in data.inventory or {} do
            if item.uniqueId and not preview.BeforeIds[item.uniqueId] and item.crafted and item.itemType == preview.WeaponType then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    return api
end

local function resolveSelling()
    local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local items = require(storage.Shared.Items)
    local stateScript = player.PlayerScripts.Client.State
    local store
    for _, candidate in filtergc("table", {Keys = {"get", "getEquipped", "equippedSlot", "findItem", "count"}}, false) do
        local ok, scope = pcall(getfenv, candidate.get)
        if ok and scope.script == stateScript then store = candidate break end
    end
    assert(store, "ไม่พบข้อมูลอาวุธในกระเป๋า")
    local remote = storage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("MerchantSell")
    assert(remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction"), "ไม่พบระบบขายของเกม")
    local api = {}
    function api.MerchantDistance()
        local c = player.Character
        local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return math.huge, 0 end
        local distance, allowed = math.huge, 0
        for _, prompt in workspace:QueryDescendants("ProximityPrompt[$Kind=Merchant]") do
            local parent = prompt.Parent
            local point = parent:IsA("Attachment") and parent.WorldPosition or parent:IsA("BasePart") and parent.Position
            if prompt.Enabled and point then
                local d = (point - root.Position).Magnitude
                if d < distance then distance, allowed = d, prompt.MaxActivationDistance end
            end
        end
        return distance, allowed
    end
    local function describe(item, data, locks)
        local desc = items.get(item)
        if not desc or not items.WEAPON_TYPES[desc.itemType] or type(item.uniqueId) ~= "string" then return end
        local equipped = store.equippedSlot(item.uniqueId) ~= nil
        for _, id in data.equipment or {} do if id == item.uniqueId then equipped = true break end end
        local locked = locks and locks[item.uniqueId] == true
        local sellable = items.canSell(item)
        local price = items.getSellPrice(item)
        local reason = equipped and "ถอดอาวุธชิ้นนี้ก่อนขาย" or locked and "ชิ้นนี้ล็อกไว้ • ปลดล็อกก่อนขาย"
            or not sellable and "เกมไม่อนุญาตให้ขายอาวุธชิ้นนี้" or price <= 0 and "อาวุธชิ้นนี้ไม่มีราคาขาย" or nil
        return {Id = item.uniqueId, Name = items.getDisplayName(item), Damage = desc.damage or 0,
            Plus = items.getPlus(item), Price = price, Equipped = equipped, Locked = locked,
            Sellable = sellable and price > 0, Ready = not reason and price > 0, Reason = reason,
            Amount = item.amount or 1, Col = data.col or 0}
    end
    function api.Catalog(locks, search)
        local data = store.get() or {}
        local rows = {}
        search = tostring(search or ""):lower()
        for _, item in data.inventory or {} do
            local entry = describe(item, data, locks)
            if entry and (search == "" or entry.Name:lower():find(search, 1, true)
                or entry.Id:lower():find(search, 1, true)) then table.insert(rows, entry) end
        end
        table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
            if a.Name ~= b.Name then return a.Name < b.Name end
            return a.Id < b.Id
        end)
        return rows
    end
    function api.Preview(id, locks)
        local data = store.get() or {}
        local entry
        for _, item in data.inventory or {} do
            if item.uniqueId == id then entry = describe(item, data, locks) break end
        end
        if not entry then return {Ready = false, Reason = "เลือกอาวุธจากรายการ", Col = data.col or 0} end
        local distance, allowed = api.MerchantDistance()
        entry.MerchantDistance = distance
        if entry.Ready and distance > allowed then
            entry.Ready = false
            entry.Reason = distance == math.huge and "ไม่พบพ่อค้าในพื้นที่" or "เข้าใกล้พ่อค้าก่อน • ห่าง " .. math.floor(distance) .. " studs"
        end
        entry.Reason = entry.Reason or "พร้อมขาย 1 ชิ้น"
        return entry
    end
    function api.SellOnce(expected, locks)
        local preview = api.Preview(expected.Id, locks)
        if not preview.Ready then return {ok = false, message = preview.Reason} end
        if preview.Price ~= expected.Price or preview.Name ~= expected.Name or preview.Damage ~= expected.Damage
            or preview.Plus ~= expected.Plus or preview.Amount ~= expected.Amount then
            return {ok = false, message = "ข้อมูลอาวุธเปลี่ยน • เลือกและยืนยันใหม่"}
        end
        expected.BeforeCol, expected.BeforeAmount = preview.Col, preview.Amount
        expected.Submitted = true
        -- Same remote and argument order as the game's Merchant UI. Always one selected item.
        return remote:InvokeServer(expected.Id, 1)
    end
    function api.BatchPreview(selection, locks)
        local data = store.get() or {}
        local byId, ids = {}, {}
        for _, item in data.inventory or {} do
            if selection[item.uniqueId] then byId[item.uniqueId] = item end
        end
        for id, selected in selection do if selected == true and type(id) == "string" then table.insert(ids, id) end end
        table.sort(ids)
        local batch = {Entries = {}, Count = #ids, Total = 0, Col = data.col or 0, Ready = #ids > 0}
        for _, id in ids do
            local entry = byId[id] and describe(byId[id], data, locks)
            if not entry then entry = {Id = id, Ready = false, Price = 0, Reason = "มีอาวุธที่ไม่อยู่ในกระเป๋าแล้ว"} end
            table.insert(batch.Entries, entry)
            batch.Total += entry.Price
            if not entry.Ready then batch.Ready, batch.Reason = false, batch.Reason or entry.Reason end
        end
        batch.CanTravel = batch.Ready
        if #ids == 0 then batch.Reason = "ติ๊กเลือกอาวุธจากรายการได้หลายชิ้น"
        elseif batch.Ready then
            local distance, allowed = api.MerchantDistance()
            if distance > allowed then
                batch.Ready = false
                batch.Reason = distance == math.huge and "ไม่พบพ่อค้าในพื้นที่" or "เข้าใกล้พ่อค้าก่อน • ห่าง " .. math.floor(distance) .. " studs"
            else batch.Reason = "พร้อมขายรายการที่เลือก" end
        end
        return batch
    end
    function api.SameBatch(expected, current, allowTravel)
        if not (current.Ready or allowTravel and current.CanTravel) or expected.Count ~= current.Count or expected.Total ~= current.Total then return false end
        for i, a in expected.Entries do
            local b = current.Entries[i]
            if not b or a.Id ~= b.Id or a.Name ~= b.Name or a.Price ~= b.Price or a.Damage ~= b.Damage
                or a.Plus ~= b.Plus or a.Amount ~= b.Amount then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    function api.Settled(receipt)
        if not receipt or not receipt.Submitted then return false end
        local data = store.get() or {}
        local remaining = 0
        for _, item in data.inventory or {} do
            if item.uniqueId == receipt.Id then remaining = item.amount or 1 break end
        end
        local acknowledged = receipt.Called == true and receipt.Returned == true
            and type(receipt.Response) == "table" and receipt.Response.ok == true
        -- Other purchases can change Col while a sale is in flight. A native success response
        -- plus removal of this exact UUID is sufficient; an unknown response still needs both deltas.
        return remaining == receipt.BeforeAmount - 1 and (acknowledged or (data.col or 0) >= receipt.BeforeCol + receipt.Price)
    end
    return api
end


local function createSellBatchRunner(api, options)
    options = options or {}
    local now = options.Clock or os.clock
    local spawn = options.Spawn or task.spawn
    local cancel = options.Cancel or function(thread) if thread then pcall(task.cancel, thread) end end
    local function status(job, text)
        job.Status = text
        if options.OnStatus then options.OnStatus(job, text) end
    end
    local function finish(job, reason)
        if job.Finished then return end
        job.Finished = true
        status(job, reason or ("ขายสำเร็จ " .. job.Completed .. "/" .. job.Count .. " ชิ้น • +" .. job.Earned .. " Col"))
        if options.OnFinish then options.OnFinish(job) end
    end
    local runner = {}
    function runner.Start(batch)
        local entries = {}
        for _, entry in batch.Entries do table.insert(entries, table.clone(entry)) end
        return {Entries = entries, Count = #entries, Total = batch.Total, Index = 1, Completed = 0,
            Earned = 0, NextAt = now(), Cancelled = false, Finished = false, Status = "เริ่มขายรายการที่เลือก"}
    end
    function runner.Cancel(job)
        if job and not job.Finished then
            job.Cancelled = true
            status(job, job.Receipt and "กำลังหยุด • รอผลชิ้นปัจจุบัน" or "กำลังหยุดรายการที่เหลือ")
        end
    end
    function runner.Step(job)
        if not job or job.Finished then return end
        local receipt = job.Receipt
        if receipt then
            if api.Settled(receipt) then
                receipt.Done = true
                if receipt.Thread then cancel(receipt.Thread) end
                job.Completed += 1
                job.Earned += receipt.Price
                job.Index += 1
                job.Receipt = nil
                job.NextAt = now() + 0.4
                if options.OnCommit then options.OnCommit(job, receipt) end
                status(job, "ขายสำเร็จ " .. job.Completed .. "/" .. job.Count .. " ชิ้น • +" .. job.Earned .. " Col")
            elseif receipt.Returned then
                if not receipt.Submitted or (receipt.Called and type(receipt.Response) == "table" and receipt.Response.ok == false) then
                    local message = type(receipt.Response) == "table" and receipt.Response.message
                    job.Receipt = nil
                    finish(job, (message or "ขายไม่สำเร็จ") .. " • หยุดรายการที่เหลือ (สำเร็จ " .. job.Completed .. " ชิ้น)")
                else
                    status(job, "รอตรวจอาวุธและ Col • ไม่ส่งชิ้นถัดไปซ้ำ")
                end
            elseif now() - receipt.StartedAt >= 12 then
