        }
        if test then
            -- Show real current values as a connection preview, never as invented gains.
            local previewKeys = {}
            for key in observedLevels do table.insert(previewKeys, key) end
            table.sort(previewKeys)
            if #previewKeys > 0 then
                embed.description ..= "\n**ตัวอย่างเลเวลปัจจุบัน — ไม่ใช่เลเวลอัป**"
                for index = 1, math.min(#previewKeys, 18) do
                    local key = previewKeys[index]
                    table.insert(embed.fields, {name = levelNames[key] or ("✨ " .. key), inline = true,
                        value = "Lv." .. oreNumber(observedLevels[key]) .. " · ปัจจุบัน"})
                end
            end
        end
        if isLevelBatch then
            embed.title = "🌹 เลเวลอัปแล้ว!"
            embed.description = "เพิ่มรวม **" .. oreNumber(levelCount(levelBatch)) .. " เลเวล**"
            embed.color = 0x9681BD
            embed.fields = {}
            for _, event in levelBatch do
                table.insert(embed.fields, {name = levelNames[event.Key] or ("✨ " .. event.Key), inline = true,
                    value = "**Lv." .. oreNumber(event.From) .. " → Lv." .. oreNumber(event.To) .. "**\nเพิ่ม " .. oreNumber(event.To - event.From) .. " เลเวล"})
            end
            embed.footer.text = "❄️ EVERNIGHT • " .. player.Name .. "  /  ทุกความก้าวหน้า  /  #" .. sequence
        end
        job = attachArtwork({Url = url, Epoch = epoch, Test = test, Steel = amountSteel, Iron = amountIron, Crystal = amountCrystal, Floor = reportFloor,
            Kind = test and "Test" or isLevelBatch and "Levels" or "Ore", Levels = copyEvents(levelBatch),
            Failures = 0, RateRetries = 0, Attempt = 0, DueAt = now}, embed)
        sendAttempt(job)
    end
    observeLevels(enabled)
    publish()
end

-- Read-only Floor 2 quest browser. No travel, quest, reward, or combat requests.
questBrowser = {Rows = {}, Filters = {}}
do
    local api, byId = questBrowser, {}
    local groups = {All = "ทั้งหมด", NPC = "NPC", Story = "เนื้อเรื่อง", BlackCats = "Black Cats", Soon = "เร็ว ๆ นี้"}
    local statuses = {Open = "เปิดแล้ว", Locked = "ยังล็อก", ComingSoon = "เร็ว ๆ นี้", Complete = "ผ่านแล้ว"}
    for _, q in floor2QuestCatalog do byId[q.Id] = q end
    state.QuestFilter = groups[previousSettings.QuestFilter] and previousSettings.QuestFilter or "All"
    state.QuestSearch = type(previousSettings.QuestSearch) == "string" and previousSettings.QuestSearch:sub(1,120) or ""
    state.SelectedQuest = byId[previousSettings.SelectedQuest] and previousSettings.SelectedQuest or nil
    local function storyData()
        local ok, data = pcall(function()return require(player.PlayerScripts.Client.State).get()end)
        return ok and type(data) == "table" and type(data.story2) == "table" and data.story2 or {}
    end
    local function status(q, story)
        if q.Group == "Story" and type(story.completed) == "table" and story.completed[q.Id] == true then return "Complete" end
        return q.Availability
    end
    local function matches(q)
        if state.QuestFilter == "All" then
            if q.Group == "Soon" then return false end
        elseif q.Group ~= state.QuestFilter then return false end
        local query = state.QuestSearch:lower()
        local haystack = table.concat({q.Title,q.Id,groups[q.Group] or "",q.Episode or "",q.Location or "",q.Summary or "",
            q.UnlockText or "",table.concat(q.Items or {}," "),tostring(q.XP or 0),tostring(q.Col or 0),uiNumber(q.XP),uiNumber(q.Col)}," "):lower()
        return query == "" or haystack:find(query,1,true) ~= nil
    end
    function state.GetQuestInfo(id)
        local q = byId[id]
        if not q then return nil end
        return {Id=q.Id,Title=q.Title,Group=q.Group,Episode=q.Episode,Level=q.Level,Location=q.Location,Summary=q.Summary,
            XP=q.XP,Col=q.Col,Items=table.clone(q.Items or {}),Status=status(q,storyData()),UnlockText=q.UnlockText,RepeatText=q.RepeatText}
    end
    function state.GetQuestBrowserState()
        local count = 0
        for _, q in floor2QuestCatalog do if matches(q) then count += 1 end end
        return {Filter=state.QuestFilter,Search=state.QuestSearch,Selected=state.SelectedQuest,VisibleCount=count,
            QuestCount=34,ComingSoonCount=2,DetailVisible=state.SelectedQuest~=nil,ReadOnly=true}
    end
    function state.SetQuestFilter(group)
        if not groups[group] then return false end
        state.QuestFilter,state.SelectedQuest=group,nil
        if api.Scroll then api.Scroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero end
        api.Update(true)
        return true
    end
    function state.SetQuestSearch(value)
        state.QuestSearch=tostring(value or ""):sub(1,120)
        if api.Search and api.Search.Text~=state.QuestSearch then api.Search.Text=state.QuestSearch end
        if api.Scroll then api.Scroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero end
        api.Update(true)
    end
    function state.SelectQuest(id)
        if not byId[id] then return false end
        state.SelectedQuest=id
        api.ReleaseFocus()
        if api.DetailScroll then api.DetailScroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero end
        api.Update(true)
        return true
    end
    function state.ShowQuestList()
        state.SelectedQuest=nil
        api.Update(true)
    end
    function api.ReleaseFocus()
        if api.Search and api.Search:IsFocused() then api.Search:ReleaseFocus(false) end
    end
    function api.Update(force)
        if not api.Frame then return end
        local visible = currentFloor==2 and state.Mode=="Quest" and not state.SettingsOpen
        api.Frame.Visible=visible
        if not visible then api.ReleaseFocus() return end
        local story, signature = storyData(), {}
        for _,q in floor2QuestCatalog do table.insert(signature,status(q,story)) end
        local key=state.QuestFilter.."\0"..state.QuestSearch.."\0"..tostring(state.SelectedQuest)..table.concat(signature,",")
        if key==api.LastKey and not force then return end
        api.LastKey=key
        local selected=byId[state.SelectedQuest]
        api.ListPage.Visible,api.DetailPage.Visible=selected==nil,selected~=nil
        api.Clear.Visible=state.QuestSearch~=""
        for group,b in api.Filters do view.PaintButton(b,state.QuestFilter==group) end
        local count=0
        for _,q in floor2QuestCatalog do
            local b, show = api.Rows[q.Id], matches(q)
            b.Visible=show
            if show then count+=1 end
            local s=status(q,story)
            b.Status.Text=statuses[s] or s
            b.Status.TextColor3=(s=="Open" or s=="Complete") and theme.Frost or theme.Muted
        end
        api.Count.Text=state.QuestFilter=="Soon" and (count.." รายการรออัปเดต · ไม่มีรางวัลกำหนด")
            or ("แสดง "..count.." / 34 เควส · กดเพื่อดูรางวัล")
        api.Empty.Visible=count==0 and selected==nil
        if selected then
            local q,s=selected,status(selected,story)
            api.Badge.Text=statuses[s] or s
            api.Badge.TextColor3=(s=="Open" or s=="Complete") and theme.Frost or theme.AccentLight
            api.DetailTitle.Text=q.Title
            api.Meta.Text=(groups[q.Group] or q.Group)..(q.Episode and (" · "..q.Episode) or "")..(q.Level and (" · Lv."..q.Level) or "")
            api.Location.Text="จุดเริ่ม: "..(q.Location or "ตามเนื้อเรื่อง")
            api.Rewards.Text=q.Group=="Soon" and "ยังไม่กำหนดรางวัล" or (uiNumber(q.XP).." XP   ·   "..uiNumber(q.Col).." Col")
            api.Items.Text=#(q.Items or {})>0 and table.concat(q.Items,"\n") or "ไม่มีไอเทมรางวัลเพิ่มเติม"
            api.Objective.Text=q.Summary or "รอข้อมูลจากเกม"
            api.Unlock.Text=(s=="Complete" and "ตัวละครนี้ผ่านแล้ว\n" or "")..(q.UnlockText or "เปิดให้ดูข้อมูลแล้ว")
                ..(q.RepeatText and ("\n"..q.RepeatText) or "")
        end
    end
    function api.Mount(parent,h)
        local make,button=h.Make,h.Button
        local frame=make("Frame",{Name="QuestBrowser",BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,92),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(280,306),Visible=false},parent)
        api.Frame=frame
        api.ListPage=make("Frame",{Name="ListPage",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1},frame)
        local title=h.Text("Title","เควส · โลก 2",0,0,200,22,api.ListPage,16,theme.Text)
        title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        local total=h.Text("Total","34 เควส",204,1,76,20,api.ListPage,11,theme.Frost)
        total.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        api.Search=h.Field("QuestSearch",state.QuestSearch,"ค้นหาชื่อ / มอน / ไอเทมรางวัล",0,28,280,28,api.ListPage)
        api.Search.TextSize=11
        api.Search.UIPadding.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,30)
        connect(api.Search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),function()state.SetQuestSearch(api.Search.Text)end)
        api.Clear=button("×",UDim2.fromOffset(24,22),UDim2.fromOffset(252,31),api.ListPage)
        api.Clear.Name,api.Clear.BackgroundTransparency="ClearQuestSearch",1
        connect(api.Clear.Activated,function()state.SetQuestSearch("")end)
        local x=0
        for _,g in {{"All",46},{"NPC",43},{"Story",70},{"BlackCats",65},{"Soon",44}} do
            local b=button(groups[g[1]],UDim2.fromOffset(g[2],25),UDim2.fromOffset(x,63),api.ListPage)
            b.Name,b.TextSize="Filter_"..g[1],10
            api.Filters[g[1]]=b
            local group=g[1]
            connect(b.Activated,function()state.SetQuestFilter(group)end)
            x+=g[2]+3
        end
        api.Count=h.Text("ResultCount","",0,92,280,17,api.ListPage,10,theme.Muted)
        api.Scroll=make("ScrollingFrame",{Name="QuestList",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,113),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(280,171),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=3,ScrollBarImageColor3=theme.Accent,CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,ClipsDescendants=true},api.ListPage)
        make("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,5),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder},api.Scroll)
        make("UIPadding",{PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,1),PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,1),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,2)},api.Scroll)
        for order,q in floor2QuestCatalog do
            local b=button("",UDim2.new(1,-6,0,52),UDim2.new(),api.Scroll)
            b.Name,b.LayoutOrder="Quest_"..q.Id,order
            b.BackgroundTransparency=.34
            local label=h.Text("Title",q.Title,10,5,204,21,b,12,theme.Text)
            label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
            h.Text("Status","",217,6,50,18,b,9,theme.Frost).TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
            h.Text("Reward",q.Group=="Soon" and "Coming Soon · ยังไม่กำหนดรางวัล" or
                (uiNumber(q.XP).." XP · "..uiNumber(q.Col).." Col"..(#(q.Items or {})>0 and " · ไอเทม" or "")),10,29,254,17,b,10,theme.Muted)
            api.Rows[q.Id]=b
            local id=q.Id
            connect(b.Activated,function()state.SelectQuest(id)end)
        end
        api.Empty=h.Text("Empty","ไม่พบเควสนี้\nลองชื่อมอน ไอเทม หรือหมวดอื่น",8,140,264,62,api.ListPage,12,theme.Muted)
        api.Empty.TextWrapped=true
        api.DetailPage=make("Frame",{Name="DetailPage",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false},frame)
        local back=button("‹ รายการ",UDim2.fromOffset(80,27),UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),api.DetailPage)
        back.Name,back.TextSize="BackToQuestList",11
        connect(back.Activated,state.ShowQuestList)
        api.Badge=h.Text("Availability","",90,3,190,21,api.DetailPage,11,theme.Frost)
        api.Badge.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        api.DetailScroll=make("ScrollingFrame",{Name="QuestDetails",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,36),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(280,248),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=3,ScrollBarImageColor3=theme.Accent,CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,ClipsDescendants=true},api.DetailPage)
        make("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,7),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder},api.DetailScroll)
        make("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,2),PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,1),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,8)},api.DetailScroll)
        local order=0
        local function detailText(name,size,color,bold)
            order+=1
            local l=h.Text(name,"",0,0,268,0,api.DetailScroll,size,color)
            l.Size,l.AutomaticSize=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,0),Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            l.TextWrapped,l.TextTruncate,l.TextYAlignment=true,Enum.TextTruncate.None,Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
            l.LayoutOrder=order
            if bold then l.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold end
            return l
        end
        api.DetailTitle=detailText("QuestTitle",17,theme.Text,true)
        api.Meta=detailText("Category",10,theme.Muted)
        api.Location=detailText("Location",11,theme.Frost)
        local rewards=h.Card("Rewards",0,0,268,62,api.DetailScroll)
        order+=1
        rewards.Size,rewards.LayoutOrder=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,62),order
        h.Text("Heading","รางวัลที่ได้รับ",10,5,246,18,rewards,10,theme.Muted)
        api.Rewards=h.Text("Amount","",10,25,246,26,rewards,14,theme.AccentLight)
        api.Rewards.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        detailText("ItemHeading",11,theme.Muted,true).Text="ไอเทมรางวัล"
        api.Items=detailText("Items",12,theme.Frost)
        detailText("ObjectiveHeading",11,theme.Muted,true).Text="เป้าหมาย"
        api.Objective=detailText("Objective",12,theme.Text)
        detailText("UnlockHeading",11,theme.Muted,true).Text="เงื่อนไข / สถานะ"
        api.Unlock=detailText("Unlock",11,theme.Frost)
        h.Text("ReadOnly","ดูข้อมูลเท่านั้น · ยังไม่รับหรือทำออโต้",0,290,280,16,frame,10,theme.Muted)
        api.Update(true)
    end
end
end
-- END FLOOR 2 QUEST BROWSER

local function updateStatus()
    if not statusLabel then return end
    local setIdentity = setthreadidentity or setidentity
    local getIdentity = getthreadidentity or getidentity
    local previous = getIdentity and getIdentity()
    local heading, detail, selection = state.Status, "เลือกเป้าหมาย แล้วกดเริ่ม", oreChoiceName(state.Selected)
    local action = (state.Enabled and "หยุด" or "เริ่ม") .. (state.Mode == "Mining" and "ขุดแร่  ·  F7" or "ตีมอน  ·  F6")
    local actionColor = state.Enabled and theme.Stop or theme.Accent
    local materialText, capacityText, lockText = "", "", "ล็อกชิ้นนี้"
    local batch, recipe
    if state.Mode == "Craft" and crafting then
        recipe = crafting.Preview(state.SelectedWeapon, state.CraftMaterial, state.CraftQuantity)
        selection = recipe.Name or "เลือกอาวุธ"
        heading = not recipe.Ready and not state.Crafting and recipe.Reason or state.CraftStatus
        materialText = crafting.MaterialLabel(state.CraftMaterial):gsub(" Ingot$", "") .. " ▾"
        capacityText = "ได้ " .. uiNumber(recipe.Max) .. " ชิ้น"
        detail = "ใช้ " .. uiNumber(recipe.Need) .. " / มี " .. uiNumber(recipe.Have) .. "  ·  DMG " .. uiNumber(recipe.Damage)
            .. "\nLv." .. uiNumber(recipe.WeaponLevel) .. "  ·  มูลค่า " .. uiNumber(recipe.Value) .. " Col"
        action = state.Crafting and (state.CraftCancel and "รอชิ้นปัจจุบันเสร็จ" or "หยุดหลังชิ้นนี้")
            or ((not recipe.Ready and recipe.CanTravel and "เดินไปคราฟ " or "คราฟ ") .. state.CraftQuantity .. " ชิ้น  ·  ใช้ " .. uiNumber(recipe.Need))
        actionColor = state.Crafting and theme.Stop or recipe.CanTravel and theme.Accent or theme.Disabled
    elseif state.Mode == "Sell" and selling then
        local item = selling.Preview(state.SelectedSellId, state.SellLocks)
        batch = selling.BatchPreview(state.SellSelection, state.SellLocks)
        if state.SellConfirmation and not state.Selling and not selling.SameBatch(state.SellConfirmation, batch, true) then
            state.SellConfirmation = nil
            state.SellStatus = batch.Ready and "รายการเปลี่ยน • ตรวจและยืนยันใหม่" or batch.Reason
        end
        local job = state.SellBatch
        selection = state.Selling and job and ("ขาย " .. job.Completed .. "/" .. job.Count .. " ชิ้น")
            or ("เลือก " .. batch.Count .. "  ·  " .. uiNumber(batch.Total) .. " Col")
        heading = state.Selling and state.SellStatus or state.SellConfirmation and "ยืนยันรายการนี้ก่อนขาย"
            or batch.Count > 0 and not batch.CanTravel and batch.Reason or state.SellStatus
        detail = item.Id and (item.Name .. "  ·  #" .. item.Id:sub(1,8)) or "ติ๊กเลือกหลายชิ้นได้  ·  ของล็อก / สวมอยู่จะไม่ขาย"
        detail ..= "\nCol " .. uiNumber(batch.Col) .. "  ·  ขายแล้ว " .. uiNumber(state.SoldCount) .. " ชิ้น"
        action = state.Selling and (job.Cancelled and "รอผลชิ้นปัจจุบัน" or "หยุดขายหลังชิ้นนี้")
            or state.SellConfirmation and ((batch.Ready and "ยืนยันขาย " or "ยืนยันไปขาย ") .. state.SellConfirmation.Count .. " ชิ้น  ·  " .. uiNumber(state.SellConfirmation.Total) .. " Col")
            or batch.Count > 0 and ((batch.Ready and "ขายที่เลือก " or "เดินไปขาย ") .. batch.Count .. " ชิ้น  ·  " .. uiNumber(batch.Total) .. " Col")
            or "ติ๊กเลือกอาวุธก่อนขาย"
        actionColor = state.Selling and theme.Stop or state.SellConfirmation and theme.Selected or batch.CanTravel and theme.Accent or theme.Disabled
        lockText = item.Locked and "ปลดล็อกชิ้นนี้" or "ล็อกชิ้นนี้"
    elseif state.Mode == "Quest" then
        selection = "Hold the Forge"
        local seconds = math.ceil(state.QuestRemaining or 0)
        detail = state.QuestPhase == "Cooldown" and string.format("รออีก %02d:%02d นาที", math.floor(seconds/60),seconds%60)
            or state.QuestPhase == "Defend" and state.QuestGuardRemaining and string.format("ป้องกันอีก %02d:%02d นาที", math.floor(state.QuestGuardRemaining/60),state.QuestGuardRemaining%60)
            or state.QuestHave and state.QuestNeed and ("ภารกิจ " .. uiNumber(state.QuestHave) .. " / " .. uiNumber(state.QuestNeed))
            or "ป้องกันโรงตีเหล็ก 3 นาที  ·  ทำซ้ำทุก 50 นาที"
        detail ..= "\nสำเร็จ " .. uiNumber(state.QuestRuns) .. " รอบ  ·  พลาด " .. uiNumber(state.QuestFailures) .. " รอบ"
        action = state.Enabled and "หยุดออโต้เควส" or "เริ่มออโต้เควส"
        if currentFloor == 2 then
            heading, detail = "เควสชั้น 2 • ตรวจข้อมูลเท่านั้น", "เลือกเควสเพื่อดูเป้าหมาย รางวัล และเงื่อนไข"
            action, actionColor = "ยังไม่เปิดออโต้เควสชั้น 2", theme.Disabled
        end
    elseif state.Mode == "Mining" then
        detail = (currentFloor == 2 and ("Crystallite +" .. uiNumber(state.CrystalliteGained))
            or ("Steel +" .. uiNumber(state.SteelGained) .. "  ·  Iron +" .. uiNumber(state.IronGained)))
            .. "\n" .. (state.SelectedOre == "CaveSteelFirst" and "เฉพาะในถ้ำ  ·  Steel มาก่อน Iron" or oreChoiceName(state.SelectedOre))
    else
        local target = state.Target
        detail = target and target.Parent and (mobName(target) .. "  ·  Lv." .. tostring(target:GetAttribute("Level") or "?")) or "เลือกมอนสเตอร์จากรายการ"
        detail ..= "\nตี " .. uiNumber(state.Attacks) .. " ครั้ง  ·  จัดการ " .. uiNumber(state.Kills) .. " ตัว"
    end
    if state.Respawning then
        heading, detail = state.RespawnStatus, "เกิดใหม่ปกติฟรี  ·  ไม่ใช้ Robux\nEXP ยังเป็นไปตามกติกาเกม"
        action, actionColor = state.Enabled and "หยุดฟาร์ม  ·  รอเกิดใหม่ฟรี" or "กำลังเกิดใหม่แบบฟรี", theme.Disabled
    elseif state.Travelling then
        heading, detail = state.TravelStatus, "ถึงจุดแล้วตรวจรายการอีกครั้ง\nกดปุ่มด้านล่างเพื่อหยุดเดิน"
        action, actionColor = "หยุดเดินไป" .. (state.TravelJob.Kind == "Craft" and "เตาหลอม" or "พ่อค้า"), theme.Stop
    end
    if setIdentity then setIdentity(8) end
    view.StatusHeading.Text, statusLabel.Text = heading or "พร้อมใช้งาน", detail
    selectedLabel.Text = selection
    startButton.Text, startButton.BackgroundColor3 = action, actionColor
    local compactControls = state.Mode == "Craft" or state.Mode == "Sell"
    list.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, compactControls and 114 or 142)
    craftControls.Visible, sellControls.Visible = state.Mode == "Craft", state.Mode == "Sell"
    craftMaterialButton.Visible, sellSelectAllButton.Visible, warpButton.Visible = state.Mode == "Craft", state.Mode == "Sell", state.Mode == "Mining"
    craftMaterialButton.Text, craftCapacityLabel.Text = materialText, capacityText
    craftQuantityBox.TextEditable = not state.Crafting and not state.Travelling
    if not craftQuantityBox:IsFocused() then craftQuantityBox.Text = tostring(state.CraftQuantity) end
    sellLockButton.Text = lockText
    sellCancelButton.Visible = batch and (batch.Count > 0 or state.SellConfirmation ~= nil or state.Selling or state.Travelling) or false
    sellCancelButton.Text = (state.Selling or state.Travelling) and "หยุด" or state.SellConfirmation and "ยกเลิก" or "ล้างที่เลือก"
    warpButton.Text = state.AutoTownWarp and "วาร์ป: เปิด" or "วาร์ป: ปิด"
    view.Search.TextEditable = not state.Selling and not state.Crafting and not state.Travelling
    view.ClearSearch.Visible = view.Search.Text ~= ""
    view.Search.PlaceholderText = state.Mode == "Sell" and "ค้นหาชื่ออาวุธ / รหัสชิ้น" or state.Mode == "Craft" and "ค้นหาชนิดอาวุธ" or state.Mode == "Mining" and (currentFloor == 2 and "ค้นหา Crystallite / เขตขุด" or "ค้นหา Steel / Iron") or "ค้นหามอนสเตอร์"
    view.Main.Visible, view.Settings.Visible = not state.SettingsOpen and not (currentFloor == 2 and state.Mode == "Quest"), state.SettingsOpen
    questBrowser.Update()
    view.MaterialPopup.Visible = state.Mode == "Craft" and state.MaterialPickerOpen and not state.SettingsOpen
    view.PaintButton(combatTab, state.Mode == "Combat")
    view.PaintButton(miningTab, state.Mode == "Mining")
    view.PaintButton(craftTab, state.Mode == "Craft")
    view.PaintButton(sellTab, state.Mode == "Sell")
    view.PaintButton(view.QuestTab, state.Mode == "Quest")
    view.QuestInfo.Visible, list.Visible, view.Search.Visible = state.Mode == "Quest", state.Mode ~= "Quest", state.Mode ~= "Quest"
    selectedLabel.Visible = state.Mode ~= "Quest"
    if state.Mode == "Quest" then view.ClearSearch.Visible = false end
    view.PaintButton(view.SettingsButton, state.SettingsOpen)
    webhookToggle.Text = state.WebhookEnabled and "แจ้งเตือน: เปิด" or "แจ้งเตือน: ปิด"
    view.PaintButton(webhookToggle, state.WebhookEnabled)
    webhookLabel.Text = state.WebhookStatus or "ยังไม่ได้ตั้งค่า"
    webhookBox.PlaceholderText = state.WebhookConfigured and "บันทึกลิงก์แล้ว • วางเพื่อเปลี่ยน" or "วาง Discord Webhook URL"
    autoRespawnButton.Text = state.AutoRespawn and "เกิดใหม่ฟรี: เปิด" or "เกิดใหม่ฟรี: ปิด"
    autoRespawnButton.TextColor3 = state.AutoRespawn and theme.Frost or theme.Muted
    view.RespawnSettings.Text = state.AutoRespawn and "เปิดอยู่" or "ปิดอยู่"
    view.PaintButton(view.RespawnSettings, state.AutoRespawn)
    continuity.SyncIdle(state)
    view.AntiAfkToggle.Text = state.AntiAfk and "เปิดอยู่" or "ปิดอยู่"
    view.PaintButton(view.AntiAfkToggle, state.AntiAfk)
    view.AntiAfkStatus.Text = not state.AntiAfk and "ปิดการกัน AFK แล้ว" or state.AntiAfkError and "ส่งสัญญาณไม่สำเร็จ"
        or state.AntiAfkPulses > 0 and ("ส่งสัญญาณแล้ว " .. state.AntiAfkPulses .. " ครั้ง") or "ตรวจทุก 60 วินาที"
    view.SizeButton.Text = "ขนาด " .. math.floor((view.Scale.Scale or 1)*100+0.5) .. "%"
    view.AutoPotionToggle.Text = state.AutoPotion and "เปิดอยู่" or "ปิดอยู่"
    view.PaintButton(view.AutoPotionToggle,state.AutoPotion)
    if not view.PotionThreshold:IsFocused() then view.PotionThreshold.Text = tostring(state.PotionThreshold) end
    view.PotionStatus.Text = state.AutoPotion and (state.PotionStatus or "รอตรวจยาและเลือด") or "ปิดการใช้ยาอัตโนมัติ"
    local selectedSkills = 0
    for slot,row in autoSkills.Choices() do
        local b = view.SkillRows[slot]
        if row.Selected then selectedSkills += 1 end
        b.Text = (row.Selected and "✓ " or "□ ") .. slot .. "  ·  " .. row.Name
        b.Detail.Text = not row.Id and "ใส่สกิลในเมนูเกมก่อน" or row.Cooldown > 0 and ("รอ " .. math.ceil(row.Cooldown) .. " วินาที")
            or ("พร้อมใช้  ·  พลังงาน " .. row.Stamina)
        b.Active, b.TextColor3 = row.Id ~= nil, row.Id and theme.Text or theme.Muted
        view.PaintButton(b,row.Selected)
    end
    view.SkillButton.Text = "สกิล " .. selectedSkills .. "/4"
    view.SkillButton.Visible = state.Mode == "Combat" or state.Mode == "Quest"
    view.SkillButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(182,state.Mode == "Quest" and 164 or 30)
    view.SkillPicker.Visible = state.SkillPickerOpen and not state.SettingsOpen
    view.SkillsToggle.Text = state.SkillsEnabled and "ออโต้สกิล: เปิด" or "ออโต้สกิล: ปิด"
    view.PaintButton(view.SkillsToggle,state.SkillsEnabled)
    if view.InventoryButton then
        local busy = state.InventoryWebhookBusy == true
        local remaining = math.max(0,math.ceil((state.InventoryWebhookCooldownUntil or 0)-os.clock()))
        view.InventoryButton.Text = busy and "ส่ง..." or remaining>0 and ("รอ "..remaining) or "ไอเทม"
        view.InventoryButton.Active,view.InventoryButton.AutoButtonColor = not busy,not busy
        view.PaintButton(view.InventoryButton,busy)
        if busy then state.InventoryNoticeUntil = os.clock()+5 end
        view.InventoryToast.Visible = os.clock()<(state.InventoryNoticeUntil or 0)
        autoRespawnButton.Visible,view.Keys.Visible = not view.InventoryToast.Visible,not view.InventoryToast.Visible
        view.InventoryNoticeText.Text = state.InventoryWebhookStatus or "ส่งเฉพาะไอเทมในกระเป๋าไป Discord"
    end
    if view.UiChrome then view.UiChrome() end
    if previous and setIdentity then setIdentity(previous) end
end


local hudThread, lastHudAt = nil, -100
local function queueStatus()
    if os.clock() - lastHudAt < 0.25 then return end
    if hudThread and coroutine.status(hudThread) ~= "dead" then return end
    lastHudAt = os.clock()
    hudThread = task.spawn(function()
        local ok, problem = xpcall(updateStatus, debug.traceback)
        if not ok then state.LastUiError = tostring(problem) end
    end)
    state.HudThread = hudThread
end

function state.ShowSettings(open)
    state.WorldOpen=false
    state.SettingsOpen, state.MaterialPickerOpen, state.SkillPickerOpen = open == true, false, false
    if state.SettingsOpen and view.Search then view.Search:ReleaseFocus(false) end
    if state.SettingsOpen then questBrowser.ReleaseFocus() end
    if not state.SettingsOpen and webhookBox then webhookBox:ReleaseFocus(false) end
    if not state.SettingsOpen and view.PotionThreshold then view.PotionThreshold:ReleaseFocus(false) end
    updateStatus()
end

function state.SetPotionThreshold(value)
    local parsed = tonumber(value)
    if parsed and parsed == parsed and math.abs(parsed) ~= math.huge then state.PotionThreshold = math.clamp(math.floor(parsed),1,99) end
    updateStatus()
end
function state.SetAutoPotion(enabled)
    state.AutoPotion = enabled == true
    if potionController and potionController.SetEnabled then potionController.SetEnabled(state.AutoPotion) end
    updateStatus()
end

function state.ToggleSkillPicker()
    state.SkillPickerOpen, state.MaterialPickerOpen = not state.SkillPickerOpen, false
    updateStatus()
end
function state.ToggleSkillSlot(slot)
    local row = autoSkills.Choices()[slot]
    if row and row.Id then state.SkillSelection[row.Id] = not state.SkillSelection[row.Id] end
    updateStatus()
end
function state.SetSkillsEnabled(enabled)
    state.SkillsEnabled = enabled == true
    if not state.SkillsEnabled then autoSkills.Cancel() end
    updateStatus()
end

-- Shared anti-idle watchdog: independent of farming, character and camera lifetime.
function state.SetAntiAfk(enabled)
    if not state.Alive then return end
    state.AntiAfk=enabled==true
    continuity.IdleGuard.SetEnabled(state.AntiAfk)
    continuity.SyncIdle(state)
    continuity.Save(state,true)
    queueStatus()
end
function state.HandleIdle(seconds)
    return continuity.IdleGuard.OnIdle(seconds)
end
function state.GetAntiAfkStatus()
    local metrics=continuity.SyncIdle(state)
    metrics.Connection=continuity.IdleSession.Connection.Connected
    metrics.OtherInputs=continuity.IdleSession.OtherInputs
    metrics.LastOtherInput=continuity.IdleSession.LastOtherInput
    metrics.SessionStartedAt=continuity.IdleSession.StartedAt
    metrics.PreferLegacy=continuity.IdleSession.PreferLegacy
    metrics.EngineIdleEvents=continuity.IdleSession.EngineIdleEvents
    metrics.LastEngineIdleSeconds=continuity.IdleSession.LastEngineIdleSeconds
    metrics.Now=os.clock()
    return metrics
end

function state.SetChoiceSearch(query)
    if state.Selling or state.Crafting or state.Travelling then return end
    state.UiSearch[state.Mode] = tostring(query or "")
    if state.Mode == "Sell" then state.SellSearch = state.UiSearch.Sell end
    state.SellConfirmation, state.MaterialPickerOpen = nil, false
    refreshChoices()
    queueStatus()
end

function state.SetCraftMaterial(kind)
    if state.Crafting or state.Travelling or not table.find(crafting.Materials, kind) then return end
    state.CraftMaterial, state.MaterialPickerOpen = kind, false
    state.CraftStatus = crafting.Preview(state.SelectedWeapon, kind, state.CraftQuantity).Reason
    refreshChoices()
    updateStatus()
end

function state.ToggleMaterialPicker()
    if state.Crafting or state.Travelling then return end
    state.MaterialPickerOpen = not state.MaterialPickerOpen
    if state.MaterialPickerOpen then
        for kind, b in view.MaterialButtons do
            local preview = crafting.Preview(state.SelectedWeapon, kind, 1)
            local text = crafting.MaterialLabel(kind):gsub(" Ingot$", "")
            local setIdentity = setthreadidentity or setidentity
            if setIdentity then setIdentity(8) end
            b.Text = text .. ((preview.SmithLevel or 0) < (preview.RequiredSmithLevel or 0) and " 🔒" or "")
            view.PaintButton(b, kind == state.CraftMaterial)
        end
    end
    updateStatus()
end

function state.CycleUiScale()
    local sizes = {0.9, 1, 1.1}
    local index = table.find(sizes, state.UiScale) or 2
    state.UiScale = sizes[index % #sizes + 1]
    view.Fit()
    updateStatus()
end

local function stepFreeRespawn()
    if not respawnController then return end
    respawnController.Step()
    state.Respawning, state.RespawnStatus = respawnController.Waiting, respawnController.Status
    state.RespawnDeaths, state.RespawnRequests, state.Respawns = respawnController.Deaths, respawnController.Requests, respawnController.Completed
end

function state.SetAutoRespawn(enabled)
    if not state.Alive or not respawnController then return end
    state.AutoRespawn = enabled == true
    respawnController.SetEnabled(state.AutoRespawn)
    stepFreeRespawn()
    queueStatus()
end

function state.GetRespawnStatus()
    return {Enabled = state.AutoRespawn, Waiting = state.Respawning, Deaths = state.RespawnDeaths,
        Requests = state.RespawnRequests, Completed = state.Respawns, Status = state.RespawnStatus, FreeOnly = true}
end

function state.CancelServiceTravel(reason)
    if state.Travelling and travelController then
        travelController.Cancel(state.TravelJob, reason or "หยุดเดินแล้ว • ยังไม่ได้ทำรายการ")
        queueStatus()
    end
end

function state.GoToService(kind, onArrive)
    if not state.Alive or (kind ~= "Craft" and kind ~= "Sell") then return false end
    if state.Crafting or state.Selling or state.RestoringEquipment or savedMiningEquipment then return false end
    if state.Travelling then state.CancelServiceTravel() end
    if state.Mode ~= kind then state.SetMode(kind) end
    state.SetEnabled(false)
    cancelAction()
    stopMovement()
    invalidateRoute()
    pcall(function() setSprint(false, true) end)
    local job, problem = travelController.Start(kind, onArrive)
    if not job then
        if kind == "Craft" then state.CraftStatus = problem else state.SellStatus = problem end
        queueStatus()
        return false
    end
    state.TravelJob, state.Travelling, state.TravelStatus = job, true, job.Status
    state.TravelDistance = 0
    queueStatus()
    return true
end

function state.GetTravelStatus()
    local job = state.TravelJob
    return {Active = state.Travelling, Kind = job and job.Kind, Status = state.TravelStatus,
        Distance = state.TravelDistance, Arrived = job and job.Arrived, Replans = job and job.Replans}
end

function state.SetEnabled(enabled)
    if not state.Alive then return end
    if not enabled and not continuity.InternalPause then state.AutoResumePending=false state.FloorTravelResumeEnabled=nil end
    if enabled and currentFloor == 2 and state.Mode == "Quest" then
        state.Status = "เควสชั้น 2 • ตรวจข้อมูลเท่านั้น ยังไม่เปิดออโต้"
        updateStatus()
        return
    end
    if enabled and (state.Mode == "Craft" or state.Mode == "Sell" or state.Crafting or state.Selling or state.Travelling or state.FloorTravelling) then return end
    if forgeQuest and state.Mode == "Quest" and state.Enabled ~= (enabled == true) then
        forgeQuest.Reset()
        if enabled then forgeQuest.CloseMenus() end
    end
    if not enabled then cancelAction() motionController.Release() end
    if state.Enabled == (enabled == true) then return end
    if enabled then
        for _, previous in inheritedRestores do
            if previous.RestoringEquipment then
                state.Status = "กำลังคืนอุปกรณ์จากรอบก่อน กรุณารอสักครู่"
                updateStatus()
                return
            end
        end
    end
    if enabled and (state.RestoringEquipment or savedMiningEquipment) then
        restoreMiningEquipment()
        state.Status = "กำลังคืนอุปกรณ์เดิม กรุณารอสักครู่"
        local labelOk, labelProblem = pcall(updateStatus)
        if not labelOk then state.LastUiError = tostring(labelProblem) end
        return
    end
    if enabled and state.Mode == "Mining" then
        local item, tier = mining.Pickaxe()
        if not item then
            state.Status = currentFloor == 2 and "ต้องมี Crystallite Pickaxe ขึ้นไป • ยังไม่ซื้อให้อัตโนมัติ" or "ยังไม่มี Pickaxe • Iron Pickaxe ราคา 500 Col"
            updateStatus()
            return
        end
        if tier < mining.RequiredTier(state.Selected) then
            state.Status = "Pickaxe ระดับไม่พอสำหรับแร่ที่เลือก"
            updateStatus()
            return
        end
        savedMiningEquipment = mining.SaveEquipment()
        miningBaseline, state.OreGained = mining.Count(state.Selected), 0
        steelBaseline, ironBaseline = mining.Count("SteelOre"), mining.Count("IronOre")
        crystalliteBaseline = mining.Count("CrystalliteOre")
        state.SteelGained, state.IronGained, state.CrystalliteGained = 0, 0, 0
        startWebhookTracking()
    end
    state.Enabled = enabled == true
    if state.Enabled then
        medaiExitCleared, medaiGateCleared = false, false
        table.clear(steelRound)
    end
    if not state.Enabled then
        warpPlan = nil
        state.StaminaRecovering = false
        if state.Mode == "Mining" then stopWebhookTracking() end
    end
    state.Target, state.Distance = nil, 0
    invalidateRoute()
    lastProgress, lastPosition = os.clock(), nil
    local c, h, r = character()
    if state.Enabled then
        state.Status = "กำลังเลือกเป้าหมาย"
        if h then originals[h] = nil remember(c, h) end
        if controls and controls.controlsEnabled ~= false then
            pcall(function() controls:Disable() controlsChanged = true end)
        end
    else
        state.Status = "หยุดแล้ว"
        local saved = h and originals[h]
        pcall(function() setSprint(saved and saved.Sprinting == true, true) end)
        if h and r then
            h:MoveTo(r.Position)
            h:Move(Vector3.zero)
            if saved then h.AutoRotate = saved.AutoRotate end
        end
        if controls and controlsChanged then pcall(function() controls:Enable() end) controlsChanged = false end
        if state.Mode == "Mining" and mining then
            restoreMiningEquipment()
        end
    end
    updateStatus()
end

function state.CancelCraft()
    if state.Travelling and state.TravelJob.Kind == "Craft" then state.CancelServiceTravel() return end
    if not state.Crafting then return end
    state.CraftCancel = true
    state.CraftStatus = "กำลังหยุด • รอชิ้นปัจจุบันเสร็จ"
    queueStatus()
end

function state.SetCraftQuantity(value)
    if state.Crafting or state.Travelling then return end
    state.CraftQuantity = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or 1), 1, 99)
    state.CraftStatus = crafting.Preview(state.SelectedWeapon, state.CraftMaterial, state.CraftQuantity).Reason
    updateStatus()
end

function state.CycleCraftMaterial()
    if state.Crafting or state.Travelling then return end
    local index = table.find(crafting.Materials, state.CraftMaterial) or 0
    state.CraftMaterial = crafting.Materials[index % #crafting.Materials + 1]
    state.CraftStatus = crafting.Preview(state.SelectedWeapon, state.CraftMaterial, state.CraftQuantity).Reason
    refreshChoices()
    updateStatus()
end

function state.GetCraftPreview()
    return crafting.Preview(state.SelectedWeapon, state.CraftMaterial, state.CraftQuantity)
end

function state.CraftSelected()
    if not state.Alive or state.Mode ~= "Craft" or state.Selling then return end
    if state.Travelling then state.CancelServiceTravel() return end
    if state.Crafting then state.CancelCraft() return end
    if state.RestoringEquipment or savedMiningEquipment then
        state.CraftStatus = "รอคืนอุปกรณ์จากการขุดก่อน"
        queueStatus()
        return
    end
    for _, previous in inheritedRestores do
        if previous.RestoringEquipment then state.CraftStatus = "รอคืนอุปกรณ์จากรอบก่อน" queueStatus() return end
    end
    local c = character()
    if not c then state.CraftStatus = "รอตัวละครเกิดก่อนคราฟ" queueStatus() return end
    local kind, material, quantity = state.SelectedWeapon, state.CraftMaterial, state.CraftQuantity
    local preview = crafting.Preview(kind, material, quantity)
    if not preview.Ready then
        if preview.CanTravel then
            state.GoToService("Craft", function()
                if state.Alive and state.Mode == "Craft" and state.SelectedWeapon == kind and state.CraftMaterial == material and state.CraftQuantity == quantity then
                    state.CraftSelected()
                end
            end)
        else state.CraftStatus = preview.Reason queueStatus() end
        return
    end
    state.Crafting, state.CraftCancel, state.CraftCompleted = true, false, 0
    state.CraftStatus = "กำลังคราฟ 0/" .. quantity
    state.CraftThread = task.spawn(function()
        local setIdentity = setthreadidentity or setidentity
        if setIdentity then setIdentity(2) end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            for i = 1, quantity do
                if not state.Alive or state.CraftCancel then break end
                local ready = crafting.Preview(kind, material, 1)
                if not ready.Ready then state.CraftStatus = ready.Reason break end
                state.CraftStatus = "กำลังคราฟ " .. i .. "/" .. quantity
                state.CraftRequestPending = true
                local requestNumber = (state.CraftRequestNumber or 0) + 1
                state.CraftRequestNumber = requestNumber
                task.delay(12, function()
                    if state.Alive and state.CraftRequestPending and state.CraftRequestNumber == requestNumber then
                        state.CraftStatus = "รอเซิร์ฟเวอร์ตอบ • กดหยุดเพื่อยกเลิกชิ้นที่เหลือ"
                    end
                end)
                local called, response, before = pcall(crafting.CraftOnce, kind, material)
                state.CraftRequestPending = false
                if not called or type(response) ~= "table" then
                    state.CraftStatus = "ไม่ทราบผลคราฟ • ตรวจในกระเป๋าก่อนสั่งใหม่"
                    break
                end
                if not response.ok then state.CraftStatus = tostring(response.message or "คราฟไม่สำเร็จ") break end
                state.CraftCompleted += 1
                state.CraftedCount += 1
                state.LastCraft = {Type = kind, Material = material, Name = ready.Name, Confirmed = true}
                local untilAt = os.clock() + 3
                while state.Alive and not crafting.Settled(before) and os.clock() < untilAt do task.wait(0.1) end
                if not crafting.Settled(before) then state.CraftStatus = "คราฟสำเร็จ • รออัปเดตกระเป๋าก่อนสั่งต่อ" break end
                state.CraftStatus = "คราฟสำเร็จ " .. state.CraftCompleted .. "/" .. quantity .. " ชิ้น"
                if i < quantity then task.wait(0.5) end
            end
        end)
        state.CraftRequestPending, state.Crafting = false, false
        if not ok then state.CraftStatus = "ระบบคราฟขัดข้อง • ตรวจในกระเป๋าก่อนสั่งใหม่"
        elseif state.CraftCancel then state.CraftStatus = "หยุดแล้ว • คราฟสำเร็จ " .. state.CraftCompleted .. " ชิ้น" end
        state.CraftThread = nil
        if state.Alive then queueStatus() end
    end)
    queueStatus()
end

function state.GetSellPreview()
    return selling.Preview(state.SelectedSellId, state.SellLocks)
end

function state.GetSellBatchPreview()
    return selling.BatchPreview(state.SellSelection, state.SellLocks)
end

function state.CancelSale()
    if state.Travelling and state.TravelJob.Kind == "Sell" then state.SellConfirmation = nil state.CancelServiceTravel() return end
    if state.Selling then
        saleRunner.Cancel(state.SellBatch)
    elseif state.SellConfirmation then
        state.SellConfirmation = nil
        state.SellStatus = "ยกเลิกยืนยันแล้ว • ยังไม่ได้ขาย"
    else
        table.clear(state.SellSelection)
        state.SellStatus = "ล้างรายการที่เลือกแล้ว"
        refreshChoices()
    end
    queueStatus()
end

function state.ToggleSellSelection(id)
    if state.Selling or state.Crafting or state.Travelling then return end
    local item = selling.Preview(id, state.SellLocks)
    if not item.Id then return end
    state.SelectedSellId, state.Selected = id, id
    state.SellConfirmation = nil
    if item.Sellable and not item.Equipped and not item.Locked then
        state.SellSelection[id] = not state.SellSelection[id] or nil
        state.SellStatus = "ติ๊กเพิ่มหรือนำออกได้ • ตรวจยอดรวมก่อนขาย"
    else
        state.SellSelection[id] = nil
        state.SellStatus = item.Reason
    end
    refreshChoices()
    queueStatus()
end

function state.SelectAllSellVisible()
    if state.Selling or state.Crafting or state.Travelling then return end
    -- Read the visible query directly, including the latest keystroke before its change event runs.
    local query = sellSearchBox and sellSearchBox.Text or state.SellSearch
    state.SellSearch = query
    local added = 0
    for _, item in selling.Catalog(state.SellLocks, query) do
        if item.Ready and not state.SellSelection[item.Id] then
            state.SellSelection[item.Id] = true
            added += 1
        end
    end
    state.SellConfirmation = nil
    state.SellStatus = "เพิ่ม " .. added .. " ชิ้นตามผลค้นหา • ตรวจยอดรวมก่อนขาย"
    refreshChoices()
    queueStatus()
end

function state.ToggleSellLock()
    if state.Selling or state.Travelling or state.SelectedSellId == "" then return end
    local item = selling.Preview(state.SelectedSellId, state.SellLocks)
    if not item.Id then return end
    state.SellLocks[item.Id] = not state.SellLocks[item.Id] or nil
    if state.SellLocks[item.Id] then state.SellSelection[item.Id] = nil end
    state.SellConfirmation = nil
    state.SellStatus = state.SellLocks[item.Id] and "ล็อกอาวุธชิ้นนี้และนำออกจากรายการขายแล้ว" or "ปลดล็อกแล้ว • ติ๊กเพื่อเพิ่มเข้ารายการขาย"
    refreshChoices()
    queueStatus()
end

local function reconcileSale()
    local job = state.SellBatch
    if not job or job.Finished then return end
    saleRunner.Step(job)
    if state.SellBatch == job then
        local receipt = job.Receipt
        state.SellReceipt = receipt
        state.SellThread = receipt and receipt.Thread or nil
        state.SellRequestPending = receipt ~= nil and not receipt.Returned
    end
end

function state.SellSelected()
    if not state.Alive or state.Mode ~= "Sell" or state.Crafting then return end
    if state.Travelling then state.CancelSale() return end
    if state.Selling then state.CancelSale() return end
    if state.RestoringEquipment or savedMiningEquipment then
        state.SellStatus = "รอคืนอุปกรณ์จากการขุดก่อน" queueStatus() return
    end
    for _, previous in inheritedRestores do
        if previous.RestoringEquipment then state.SellStatus = "รอคืนอุปกรณ์จากรอบก่อน" queueStatus() return end
    end
    if not character() then state.SellStatus = "รอตัวละครเกิดก่อนขาย" queueStatus() return end
    local batch = state.GetSellBatchPreview()
    if not batch.CanTravel then state.SellConfirmation = nil state.SellStatus = batch.Reason queueStatus() return end
    local expected = state.SellConfirmation
    if not expected then
        state.SellConfirmation = batch
        state.SellStatus = "ตรวจจำนวนและยอดรวม แล้วกดยืนยันขาย"
        queueStatus()
        return
    end
    if not selling.SameBatch(expected, batch, true) then
        state.SellConfirmation = nil
        state.SellStatus = "รายการหรือราคาเปลี่ยน • ตรวจและยืนยันใหม่"
        queueStatus()
        return
    end
    if not batch.Ready then
        state.GoToService("Sell", function()
            if not state.Alive or state.Mode ~= "Sell" then return end
            local current = state.GetSellBatchPreview()
            if not selling.SameBatch(expected, current) then
                state.SellConfirmation = nil
                state.SellStatus = "รายการเปลี่ยนระหว่างเดิน • ตรวจและยืนยันใหม่"
                queueStatus()
                return
            end
            state.SellConfirmation = expected
            state.SellSelected()
        end)
        return
    end
    state.SellConfirmation = nil
    state.SellBatch = saleRunner.Start(expected)
    state.Selling = true
    state.SellStatus = "เริ่มขาย " .. expected.Count .. " ชิ้น • รวม " .. expected.Total .. " Col"
    queueStatus()
end


function state.Select(name)
    if state.Crafting or state.Selling or state.Travelling then return end
    if state.Mode == "Sell" then state.ToggleSellSelection(name) return end
    if state.Mode == "Craft" and not table.find(crafting.Types, name) then return end
    if state.Mode == "Sell" and not selling.Preview(name, state.SellLocks).Id then return end
    if state.Enabled and state.Mode == "Mining" then state.SetEnabled(false) end
    cancelAction()
    stopMovement()
    state.Selected, state.Target, state.Distance = name, nil, 0
    if state.Mode == "Mining" then state.SelectedOre = name
    elseif state.Mode == "Sell" then
        state.SelectedSellId = name
        state.SellConfirmation = nil
        state.SellStatus = "เลือกแล้ว • ตรวจชื่อ รหัส และราคาก่อนขาย"
    elseif state.Mode == "Craft" then
        state.SelectedWeapon = name
        state.CraftStatus = crafting.Preview(name, state.CraftMaterial, state.CraftQuantity).Reason
    else state.SelectedMob = name end
    invalidateRoute()
    lastProgress, lastPosition = os.clock(), nil
    local setIdentity = setthreadidentity or setidentity
    if setIdentity then setIdentity(8) end
    refreshChoices()
    updateStatus()
end

function state.SetMode(mode)
    if mode ~= "Combat" and mode ~= "Mining" and mode ~= "Craft" and mode ~= "Sell" and mode ~= "Quest" then return end
    state.ShowSettings(false)
    if state.Selling then return end
    if state.Crafting then state.CancelCraft() return end
    if state.Travelling then state.CancelServiceTravel("เปลี่ยนโหมด • หยุดเดินแล้ว") end
    if mode == state.Mode then return end
    state.SetEnabled(false)
    stopMovement()
    state.Mode = mode
    state.SkillPickerOpen = false
    state.MaterialPickerOpen = false
    state.SellSearch = state.UiSearch.Sell or ""
    if view.Search then view.Search.Text = state.UiSearch[mode] or "" end
    if list then list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero end
    state.SellConfirmation = nil
    state.Selected = mode == "Quest" and "m_forge" or mode == "Sell" and state.SelectedSellId or mode == "Craft" and state.SelectedWeapon or mode == "Mining" and state.SelectedOre or state.SelectedMob
    state.Target, state.Distance = nil, 0
    state.Status = mode == "Mining" and "เลือกชนิดแร่ แล้วกดเริ่มขุด" or "พร้อมใช้งาน"
    invalidateRoute()
    refreshChoices()
    updateStatus()
end

function state.ToggleMode(mode)
    if mode == state.Mode then state.SetEnabled(not state.Enabled)
    else state.SetMode(mode) state.SetEnabled(true) end
end

function state.ShowMenu(show)
    state.MenuVisible = show
    if panel then panel.Visible = show end
    if reopen then reopen.Visible = not show end
    if not show then
        state.SkillPickerOpen = false
        if view.SkillPicker then view.SkillPicker.Visible = false end
        if view.PotionThreshold then view.PotionThreshold:ReleaseFocus(false) end
        state.MaterialPickerOpen = false
        if view.MaterialPopup then view.MaterialPopup.Visible = false end
        if webhookBox then webhookBox:ReleaseFocus(false) end
        if craftQuantityBox then craftQuantityBox:ReleaseFocus(false) end
        if sellSearchBox then sellSearchBox:ReleaseFocus(false) end
        questBrowser.ReleaseFocus()
        UIS.MouseBehavior, UIS.MouseIconEnabled = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default, true
    end
end

function state.Destroy()
    if state.Selling then state.ShowMenu(false) return end
    if potionController then potionController.Destroy() end
    state.CancelServiceTravel("ปิดระบบ • หยุดเดินแล้ว")
    state.SetEnabled(false)
    continuity.IdleSession.Destroy()
    continuity.Stop(state)
    state.CraftCancel = true
    if state.CraftThread and state.CraftThread ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(task.cancel, state.CraftThread) end
    if state.SellThread and state.SellThread ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(task.cancel, state.SellThread) end
    state.Alive = false
    cancelWebhookRequest()
    if state.WebhookThread and state.WebhookThread ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(task.cancel, state.WebhookThread) end
    cancelAction()
    if state.StepThread and state.StepThread ~= coroutine.running() then pcall(task.cancel, state.StepThread) end
    invalidateRoute()
    for _, c in state.Connections do c:Disconnect() end
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(cursorBinding)
    UIS.MouseBehavior, UIS.MouseIconEnabled = previousMouse, previousIcon
    if gui then gui:Destroy() end
    if env.EternityAutoFarm == state then env.EternityAutoFarm = nil end
end

local function make(class, props, parent)
    local object = Instance.new(class)
    for key, value in pairs(props) do object[key] = value end
    object.Parent = parent
    return object
end

local function round(object, radius)
    make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 9)}, object)
end

local function button(text, size, pos, parent, color)
    local b = make("TextButton", {
        Text = text, Size = size, Position = pos, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        BackgroundColor3 = color or theme.Surface,
        TextColor3 = theme.Text, TextSize = 13,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, AutoButtonColor = true,
    }, parent)
    round(b, 7)
    make("UIStroke", {Name = "Outline", Color = theme.Border, Transparency = 0.45, Thickness = 1,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, b)
    return b
end

refreshChoices = function()
    if not state.Alive then return end
    local names, counts, saleEntries = {}, {}, {}
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Mobs")
    if state.Mode == "Combat" and folder then
        for _, m in folder:GetChildren() do
            if mobRoot(m) and not m:GetAttribute("IsDead") and (m:GetAttribute("Health") or 0) > 0 then
                local name = mobName(m)
                names[name], counts[name] = true, (counts[name] or 0) + 1
            end
        end
    end
    local floor = workspace:FindFirstChild("Floor" .. tostring(currentFloor))
    local zones = floor and floor:FindFirstChild("MobZones")
    if state.Mode == "Combat" and zones then
        for _, zone in zones:GetChildren() do
            local name = zone:GetAttribute("Mob")
            if typeof(name) == "string" then names[name] = true end
        end
    end
    if state.Mode == "Mining" then
        if currentFloor == 2 then
            names.CrystalliteOre, names.CrystalliteArea1, names.CrystalliteArea2 = true, true, true
        else
            names.CaveSteelFirst, names.SteelOre, names.IronOre = true, true, true
        end
        local ores = workspace:FindFirstChild("OreNodes")
        if ores then
            for _, node in ores:QueryDescendants("Model.OreNode") do
                local name = node:GetAttribute("OreType")
                if isCaveOre(node) then
                    names[name] = true
                    if node:GetAttribute("MinedOut") ~= true and node:FindFirstChild("Ore") and mobRoot(node) then
                        counts[name] = (counts[name] or 0) + 1
                        if currentFloor == 2 then
                            local areaChoice = node.Parent.Name == "Area1" and "CrystalliteArea1" or "CrystalliteArea2"
                            counts[areaChoice] = (counts[areaChoice] or 0) + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if currentFloor == 1 then counts.CaveSteelFirst = (counts.SteelOre or 0) + (counts.IronOre or 0) end
    end
    if state.Mode == "Quest" then names.m_forge = true end
    if state.Mode == "Craft" and crafting then
        for _, kind in crafting.Types do names[kind] = true end
    end
    if state.Mode == "Sell" and selling then
        for _, entry in selling.Catalog(state.SellLocks, state.SellSearch) do
            names[entry.Id], saleEntries[entry.Id] = true, entry
        end
        if state.SelectedSellId ~= "" and not selling.Preview(state.SelectedSellId, state.SellLocks).Id and not state.Selling then
            state.SelectedSellId, state.Selected, state.SellConfirmation = "", "", nil
        end
        if not state.Selling then
            local found = {}
            for _, entry in selling.Catalog(state.SellLocks, "") do found[entry.Id] = true end
            for id in state.SellSelection do
                if not found[id] then state.SellSelection[id], state.SellConfirmation = nil, nil end
            end
        end
    else
        names[state.Selected] = true
        local query = tostring(state.UiSearch[state.Mode] or ""):lower()
        if query ~= "" then
            for name in names do
                local label = state.Mode == "Craft" and crafting.TypeLabel(name) or oreChoiceName(name)
                if not label:lower():find(query, 1, true) and not name:lower():find(query, 1, true) then names[name] = nil end
            end
        end
    end
    local sorted = {}
    for name in pairs(names) do table.insert(sorted, name) end
    table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
        if state.Mode == "Mining" then
            local ranks = {CaveSteelFirst = 0, SteelOre = 1, IronOre = 2, CrystalliteOre = 0, CrystalliteArea1 = 1, CrystalliteArea2 = 2}
            if (ranks[a] or 3) ~= (ranks[b] or 3) then return (ranks[a] or 3) < (ranks[b] or 3) end
            return a < b
        end
        if state.Mode == "Craft" then return (table.find(crafting.Types, a) or 99) < (table.find(crafting.Types, b) or 99) end
        if state.Mode == "Sell" then
            if (state.SellSelection[a] == true) ~= (state.SellSelection[b] == true) then return state.SellSelection[a] == true end
            local aDisabled = saleEntries[a].Equipped or saleEntries[a].Locked or not saleEntries[a].Sellable
            local bDisabled = saleEntries[b].Equipped or saleEntries[b].Locked or not saleEntries[b].Sellable
            if aDisabled ~= bDisabled then return not aDisabled end
            if saleEntries[a].Name ~= saleEntries[b].Name then return saleEntries[a].Name < saleEntries[b].Name end
            return a < b
        end
        return a < b
    end)
    local setIdentity = setthreadidentity or setidentity
    if setIdentity then setIdentity(8) end
    view.ResultCount = #sorted
    if view.Empty then view.Empty.Visible = #sorted == 0 end
    for name, b in pairs(choices) do
        if not names[name] then b:Destroy() choices[name] = nil end
    end
    for i, name in sorted do
        if not choices[name] then
            local b = button(name, UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 34), UDim2.new(), list)
            b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            b.TextTransparency = 1
            make("Frame", {Name = "SelectedBar", BackgroundColor3 = theme.AccentLight, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6), Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -12)}, b)
            make("TextLabel", {Name = "Title", Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = theme.Text,
                TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0)}, b)
            make("TextLabel", {Name = "Detail", Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = theme.Muted,
                TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 21), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 15)}, b)
            make("TextLabel", {Name = "Check", Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = theme.AccentLight,
                TextSize = 15, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 34)}, b)
            choices[name] = b
            b.Name = state.Mode == "Sell" and ("SellItem_" .. name) or name
            connect(b.Activated, function() state.Select(name) end)
        end
        local b = choices[name]
        b.LayoutOrder = i
        b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, state.Mode == "Sell" and 40 or 34)
        local title, detail
        if state.Mode == "Craft" then
            local recipe = crafting.Preview(name, state.CraftMaterial, 1)
            if setIdentity then setIdentity(8) end
            title, detail = crafting.TypeLabel(name) .. "  ·  DMG " .. uiNumber(recipe.Damage), ""
        elseif state.Mode == "Sell" then
            local entry = saleEntries[name]
            local mark = entry.Equipped and " [สวมอยู่]" or entry.Locked and " [ล็อก]" or not entry.Sellable and " [ขายไม่ได้]" or ""
            title = entry.Name .. mark
            detail = "#" .. name:sub(1, 8) .. "  ·  DMG " .. entry.Damage .. "  ·  " .. uiNumber(entry.Price) .. " Col"
        else title, detail = oreChoiceName(name) .. "  (" .. tostring(counts[name] or 0) .. ")", "" end
        local highlighted = state.Mode == "Sell" and state.SellSelection[name] or state.Mode ~= "Sell" and name == state.Selected
        if setIdentity then setIdentity(8) end
        b.Text = title .. (detail ~= "" and ("\n" .. detail) or "")
        b.Title.Text, b.Detail.Text, b.Detail.Visible = title, detail, detail ~= ""
        b.Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, state.Mode == "Sell" and 21 or 34)
        b.SelectedBar.Visible = highlighted == true
        b.Check.Text = highlighted and "✓" or state.Mode == "Sell" and "□" or ""
        view.PaintButton(b, highlighted)
        b.BackgroundTransparency = highlighted and 0.25 or 0.52
        if state.Mode == "Sell" then
            local entry = saleEntries[name]
            local unavailable = entry.Equipped or entry.Locked or not entry.Sellable
            b.Title.TextColor3 = unavailable and theme.Muted or theme.Text
            if unavailable then b.Check.Text = "—" end
        else b.Title.TextColor3 = theme.Text end
    end
end

-- Native floor travel and the World page. No transaction is automatically repeated.
worldController = (function()
    local api={Highest=1,LastRead=-10}
    local function readHighest()
        if os.clock()-api.LastRead<1 then return api.Highest end
        api.LastRead=os.clock()
        local getIdentity=getthreadidentity or getidentity
        local setIdentity=setthreadidentity or setidentity
        local previous=getIdentity and getIdentity() or 8
        if setIdentity then setIdentity(2) end
        local ok,value=pcall(function()
            local native=require(player.PlayerScripts.Client.State)
            local data=native.get()
            return data and data.floors and data.floors.remakeHighest
        end)
        if setIdentity then setIdentity(previous) end
        if ok and type(value)=="number" then api.Highest=math.clamp(math.floor(value),1,2) end
        return api.Highest
    end
    function state.SaveSettings()
        local ok=continuity.Save(state,true)
        queueStatus()
        return ok
    end
    function state.SetPersistenceEnabled(value)
        state.PersistenceEnabled=value==true
        state.SaveSettings()
    end
    function state.SetAutoJoinWorld(value)
        state.AutoJoinWorld=value==true
        state.SaveSettings()
    end
    function state.SetAutoResumeFarm(value)
        state.AutoResumeFarm=value==true
        if not state.AutoResumeFarm then state.AutoResumePending=false end
        state.SaveSettings()
    end
    function state.ShowWorldPanel(open)
        state.ShowSettings(false)
        state.WorldOpen=open==true
        if state.WorldOpen then
            if view.Search then view.Search:ReleaseFocus(false) end
            questBrowser.ReleaseFocus()
        end
        updateStatus()
    end
    function state.GetWorldStatus()
        return {Floor=currentFloor,Highest=readHighest(),Travelling=state.FloorTravelling==true,
            Status=state.FloorTravelStatus,Persistence=continuity.Store.Status,Continuation=continuity.QueueStatus,
            AutoJoinWorld=state.AutoJoinWorld,AutoResumeFarm=state.AutoResumeFarm}
    end
    function api.TravelFailed(message)
        if not state.FloorTravelling then return end
        local resume=state.FloorTravelResumeEnabled
        state.FloorTravelling,state.FloorTravelResumeEnabled,state.FloorTeleportStarted=false,nil,false
        state.FloorTravelStatus=message or "ย้ายชั้นไม่สำเร็จ • ลองใหม่ได้"
        if resume and state.AutoResumeFarm then state.SetEnabled(true) end
        continuity.Save(state,true)
        queueStatus()
    end
    function state.WarpToFloor(value)
        local floor=tonumber(value) or (value=="Floor 1" and 1 or value=="Floor 2" and 2)
        local reason
        if floor~=1 and floor~=2 then reason="ยังไม่รองรับชั้นนี้"
        elseif floor==currentFloor then reason="อยู่ชั้นนี้แล้ว"
        elseif floor>readHighest() then reason="ต้องปลดล็อกชั้นนี้ในเกมก่อน"
        elseif state.FloorTravelling then reason="กำลังย้ายชั้น กรุณารอสักครู่"
        elseif state.Crafting or state.Selling or state.Travelling then reason="รอให้รายการหรือการเดินทางปัจจุบันจบก่อน"
        elseif state.RestoringEquipment then reason="กำลังคืนอุปกรณ์ กรุณารอสักครู่" end
        if reason then state.FloorTravelStatus=reason queueStatus() return false,reason end
        local remote=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        remote=remote and remote:FindFirstChild("TeleportFloor")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            state.FloorTravelStatus="ไม่พบระบบย้ายชั้นของเกม";queueStatus();return false,state.FloorTravelStatus
        end
        state.FloorTravelResumeEnabled=state.Enabled
        state.FloorTravelling=true
        state.FloorTeleportStarted=false
        continuity.InternalPause=true
        state.SetEnabled(false)
        continuity.InternalPause=false
        state.FloorTravelStatus="กำลังเตรียมไปชั้น "..floor
        continuity.Save(state,true)
        continuity.Queue()
        task.spawn(function()
            local deadline=os.clock()+10
            while state.Alive and state.RestoringEquipment and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.2) end
            if not state.Alive then return end
            if state.RestoringEquipment then api.TravelFailed("คืนอุปกรณ์ไม่ทัน • ยังไม่ได้ย้ายชั้น");return end
            local ok=pcall(function()remote:FireServer("Floor "..floor)end)
            if not ok then api.TravelFailed();return end
            state.FloorTravelStatus="กำลังไปชั้น "..floor.." • รอเกมเชื่อมต่อ"
            queueStatus()
            local sentAt=os.clock()
            while state.Alive and state.FloorTravelling and not state.FloorTeleportStarted and os.clock()-sentAt<25 do task.wait(0.5) end
            if state.Alive and state.FloorTravelling and not state.FloorTeleportStarted then
                api.TravelFailed("เกมยังไม่ย้ายชั้น • ตรวจสถานะแล้วลองใหม่ได้")
            end
        end)
        queueStatus()
        return true
    end
    function api.Mount(parent,nav,h)
        local make,text,card,button=h.Make,h.Text,h.Card,h.Button
        local frame=make("Frame",{Name="WorldContent",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(190,64),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(280,306),
            BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false},parent)
        local names={"CombatTab","MiningTab","CraftTab","SellTab","QuestTab"}
        nav.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(152,214)
        for index,name in names do
            local b=nav[name]
            b.Position,b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,(index-1)*36),UDim2.fromOffset(152,32)
            b.NavLabel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(128,32)
            b.ActiveRail.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,7)
        end
        local tab=button("โลก",UDim2.fromOffset(152,32),UDim2.fromOffset(0,180),nav)
        tab.Name,tab.TextTransparency,tab.AutoButtonColor="WorldTab",1,false
        local tabLabel=text("NavLabel","โลกและบันทึกค่า",12,0,128,32,tab,12,theme.Frost)
        tabLabel.Font,tabLabel.TextXAlignment=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        make("Frame",{Name="ActiveRail",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,7),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(2,18),
            BackgroundColor3=theme.AccentLight,BorderSizePixel=0,Visible=false},tab)
        connect(tab.Activated,function()state.ShowWorldPanel(true)end)
        connect(tab.MouseEnter,function()view.NavHovered=tab view.PaintButton(tab,state.WorldOpen)end)
        connect(tab.MouseLeave,function()if view.NavHovered==tab then view.NavHovered=nil end view.PaintButton(tab,state.WorldOpen)end)
        local basePaint=view.PaintButton
        view.PaintButton=function(b,active)
            if b.Parent==nav and b~=tab and state.WorldOpen then active=false end
            basePaint(b,active)
        end
        text("Title","โลกและการตั้งค่า",0,0,194,24,frame,15,theme.Text).Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        local save=button("บันทึก",UDim2.fromOffset(76,24),UDim2.fromOffset(204,0),frame)
        save.Name,save.TextSize="SaveSettings",11
        connect(save.Activated,state.SaveSettings)
        local function toggleCard(name,title,caption,y,callback)
            local c=card(name,0,y,280,58,frame)
            text("Title",title,10,5,172,22,c,12,theme.Text).Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            text("Caption",caption,10,31,260,19,c,10,theme.Muted)
            local b=button("",UDim2.fromOffset(76,24),UDim2.fromOffset(194,6),c)
            b.Name,b.TextSize="Toggle",11
            connect(b.Activated,callback)
            return b,c.Caption
        end
        local remember,rememberStatus=toggleCard("Persistence","จำการตั้งค่า","",32,function()state.SetPersistenceEnabled(not state.PersistenceEnabled)end)
        local autoJoin=toggleCard("AutoJoinWorld","เข้าโลกอัตโนมัติ","เข้าโลกต่อเมื่ออยู่หน้าล็อบบี้",96,function()state.SetAutoJoinWorld(not state.AutoJoinWorld)end)
        local autoResume=toggleCard("AutoResumeFarm","ฟาร์มต่อเมื่อเข้าใหม่","เฉพาะตีมอนและขุดแร่",160,function()state.SetAutoResumeFarm(not state.AutoResumeFarm)end)
        text("FloorCaption","เดินทางข้ามชั้น",0,222,280,18,frame,10,theme.Muted)
        local floors={}
        for floor=1,2 do
            local b=button("ไปชั้น "..floor,UDim2.fromOffset(136,32),UDim2.fromOffset((floor-1)*144,244),frame)
            b.Name,b.TextSize="GoToFloor"..floor,12
            connect(b.Activated,function()state.WarpToFloor(floor)end)
            floors[floor]=b
        end
        local status=text("WorldStatus","",0,282,280,24,frame,10,theme.Frost)
        status.TextWrapped,status.TextTruncate=true,Enum.TextTruncate.None
        local chrome=view.UiChrome
        view.UiChrome=function()
            if chrome then chrome() end
            frame.Visible=state.WorldOpen==true
            if frame.Visible then
                view.Main.Visible,view.Settings.Visible=false,false
                if questBrowser.Frame then questBrowser.Frame.Visible=false end
                parent.DragHandle.PageTitle.Text="โลกและบันทึกค่า"
            end
            view.PaintButton(tab,frame.Visible)
            for _,row in {{remember,state.PersistenceEnabled},{autoJoin,state.AutoJoinWorld},{autoResume,state.AutoResumeFarm}} do
                row[1].Text=row[2] and "เปิดอยู่" or "ปิดอยู่"
                view.PaintButton(row[1],row[2])
            end
            rememberStatus.Text=continuity.Store.Status
            local highest=readHighest()
            for floor,b in floors do
                b.Text=floor==currentFloor and ("ชั้น "..floor.." • อยู่ที่นี่") or floor>highest and ("ชั้น "..floor.." • ยังล็อก") or "ไปชั้น "..floor
                b.Active=floor~=currentFloor and floor<=highest and not state.FloorTravelling
                b.BackgroundColor3=b.Active and theme.Selected or theme.Surface
                b.TextColor3=b.Active and theme.Text or theme.Muted
            end
            status.Text=state.FloorTravelStatus or continuity.QueueStatus
        end
    end
    return api
end)()

local function createGui()
    local uiRoot = player.PlayerGui
    if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
        local ok, root = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and typeof(root) == "Instance" then uiRoot = root end
    end
    local old = uiRoot:FindFirstChild("EternityAutoFarm")
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    gui = make("ScreenGui", {Name = "EternityAutoFarm", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
        DisplayOrder = 1000, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling}, uiRoot)
    state.Gui = gui
    local function text(name, value, x, y, w, h, parent, size, color)
        return make("TextLabel", {Name = name, Text = value, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x,y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w,h), TextColor3 = color or theme.Text,
            TextSize = size or 12, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd}, parent)
    end
    local function card(name, x, y, w, h, parent)
        local f = make("Frame", {Name = name, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x,y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),
            BackgroundColor3 = theme.Inset, BorderSizePixel = 0}, parent)
        round(f,8)
        make("UIStroke", {Color = theme.Border, Transparency = 0.55, Thickness = 1}, f)
        return f
    end
    local function field(name, value, placeholder, x,y,w,h,parent)
        local box = make("TextBox", {Name = name, Text = value, PlaceholderText = placeholder, ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x,y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w,h), BackgroundColor3 = theme.Surface,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, TextColor3 = theme.Text, PlaceholderColor3 = theme.Muted, TextSize = 12,
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, parent)
        round(box,7)
        make("UIStroke", {Color = theme.Border, Transparency = 0.35, Thickness = 1}, box)
        make("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,9)}, box)
        return box
    end
    view.PaintButton = function(b, active)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = active and theme.Selected or theme.Surface
        local stroke = b:FindFirstChild("Outline")
        if stroke then stroke.Color, stroke.Transparency = active and theme.Accent or theme.Border, active and 0.12 or 0.5 end
    end
    panel = make("Frame", {Name = "Panel", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(304,430), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18,18),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true}, gui)
    round(panel,12)
    make("UIGradient", {Rotation = 65, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(31,19,42),theme.Background)}, panel)

    view.InventoryNoticeText = text("Message","",8,3,264,19,view.InventoryToast,10,theme.Frost)
    view.InventoryNoticeText.ZIndex = 61
    reopen = make("ImageButton",{Name="OpenMenu",Visible=false,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(56,56),
        Position=UDim2.new(0,18,1,-74),BackgroundColor3=theme.Surface,BorderSizePixel=0,
        Image=evernightArtwork.Asset or "",ImageRectOffset=Vector2.new(120,330),ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(500,500),
        ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,AutoButtonColor=true,ClipsDescendants=true},gui)
    round(reopen,14)
    make("UIStroke",{Color=theme.Accent,Transparency=0.1,Thickness=1.5},reopen)
    local iconCaption = text("Caption","EVERNIGHT",2,42,52,12,reopen,7,theme.Text)
    iconCaption.TextXAlignment,iconCaption.Font = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Enum.Font.GothamBold
    iconCaption.BackgroundTransparency,iconCaption.BackgroundColor3 = 0.25,theme.Background
    -- Floating portrait: a click opens the menu; a drag only moves the portrait.
    do
        local pointer,dragging,dragged,cancelled
        local pressPosition,iconPosition
        local function fitIcon(position)
            local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not camera then return end
            local viewport=camera.ViewportSize
            local size=reopen.AbsoluteSize
            local width=size.X>0 and size.X or reopen.Size.X.Offset
            local height=size.Y>0 and size.Y or reopen.Size.Y.Offset
            if not position then
                local p=reopen.Position
                position=Vector2.new(viewport.X*p.X.Scale+p.X.Offset,viewport.Y*p.Y.Scale+p.Y.Offset)
            end
            reopen.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(position.X,0,math.max(0,viewport.X-width)),
                math.clamp(position.Y,0,math.max(0,viewport.Y-height)))
        end
        view.FitReopen=fitIcon
        local function isMouse(input)
            return input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        end
        local function owns(input)
            return pointer and (input==pointer or (isMouse(pointer) and isMouse(input)))
        end
        local function positionOf(input)
            if isMouse(pointer) then return UIS:GetMouseLocation() end
            return Vector2.new(input.Position.X,input.Position.Y)
        end
        local function move(input)
            if not dragging or not reopen.Visible then return end
            local delta=positionOf(input)-pressPosition
            if delta.Magnitude>=6 then dragged=true end
            if dragged then fitIcon(iconPosition+delta) end
        end
        local function cancel()
            if dragging then cancelled=true end
            dragging=false
        end
        connect(reopen.InputBegan,function(input)
            if dragging or not reopen.Visible then return end
            if not isMouse(input) and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            pointer,dragging,dragged,cancelled=input,true,false,false
            pressPosition,iconPosition=positionOf(input),reopen.AbsolutePosition
        end)
        connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(input)
            if not dragging then return end
            if (isMouse(pointer) and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)
                or (pointer.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input==pointer) then
                move(input)
            end
        end)
        connect(UIS.InputEnded,function(input)
            if not dragging or not owns(input) then return end
            move(input)
            dragging=false
            -- Keep dragged/cancelled until the next press: Activated can arrive after InputEnded.
        end)
        connect(reopen.Activated,function(input)
            if input and (isMouse(input) or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                if not owns(input) then return end
                move(input)
                if dragged or cancelled then return end
            elseif not input and (dragged or cancelled) then
                return
            end
            state.ShowMenu(true)
        end)
        connect(reopen:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),function()
            if not reopen.Visible then cancel() else fitIcon() end
        end)
        connect(UIS.WindowFocusReleased,cancel)
    end
    view.Fit = function()
        view.FitReopen()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
        local width,height = panel.Size.X.Offset,panel.Size.Y.Offset

        local x,y = panel.Position.X.Offset,panel.Position.Y.Offset
        panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x,8,math.max(8,viewport.X-width*view.Scale.Scale-8)),
            math.clamp(y,8,math.max(8,viewport.Y-height*view.Scale.Scale-8)))
    end
    local dragging,dragStart,panelStart
    connect(title.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging,dragStart,panelStart=true,input.Position,panel.Position
        end
    end)
    connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta=input.Position-dragStart
            panel.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(panelStart.X.Offset+delta.X,panelStart.Y.Offset+delta.Y)

        end
    end)
    connect(UIS.InputEnded,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging=false end
    end)
    if workspace.CurrentCamera then connect(workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"),view.Fit) end

            local _,h=character()
