    questBrowser.Mount(panel,{Text=text,Card=card,Field=field,Make=make,Button=button})
    -- Presentation only: retain every existing control, callback and artwork asset.
    do

local function chooseTarget(root)
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(state.Mode == "Mining" and "OreNodes" or "Mobs")
    if not folder then return end
    local best, distance, bestPriority = nil, math.huge, math.huge
    local candidates = state.Mode == "Mining" and folder:QueryDescendants("Model.OreNode") or folder:GetChildren()
    for _, m in candidates do
        if valid(m) and (blocked[m] or 0) < os.clock() then
            local d = (mobRoot(m).Position - root.Position).Magnitude
            if state.Mode == "Quest" then
                local guard = forgeQuest.GuardRoot()
                if guard then
                    local guardDistance = (mobRoot(m).Position-guard.Position).Magnitude
                    d = math.floor(guardDistance/8)*20 + (m:GetAttribute("Health") or 0)/100 + d*0.05
                end
            end
            local priority = state.Mode == "Mining" and state.Selected == "CaveSteelFirst"
                and (m:GetAttribute("OreType") == "SteelOre" and (steelRound[m.Name] and 2 or 0) or 1) or 0
            if priority < bestPriority or (priority == bestPriority and d < distance) then
                best, distance, bestPriority = m, d, priority
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local steelCaveEntry = Vector3.new(-2930, 178.7, -2606)
local medaiExit = Vector3.new(-2455, 107, -500)
local medaiOutside = Vector3.new(-2700, 105.81, -500)

local function inSteelCave(target)
    return currentFloor == 1 and isCaveOre(target)
end

local function oreTravelPoint(target)
    return inSteelCave(target) and steelCaveEntry or mobRoot(target).Position
end

local function oreApproaches(c, target, start)
    local center = mobRoot(target).Position
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c, target}
    params.RespectCanCollide = true
    local positions = {}
    for i = 0, 7 do
        local angle = i * math.pi / 4
        local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * 6
        local point = center + offset
        -- A short ray stays below a cave roof and selects the floor beside the ore.
        local ground = workspace:Raycast(point + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Vector3.new(0, -14, 0), params)
        if ground and ground.Normal.Y > 0.5 then
            point = ground.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
            local ceiling = workspace:Raycast(ground.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0), Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), params)
            if not ceiling and math.abs(point.Y - center.Y) <= 7 then
                table.insert(positions, {Position = point, Partial = false})
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(positions, function(a, b) return (a.Position - start).Magnitude < (b.Position - start).Magnitude end)
    return positions
end

-- The waypoint decision is pure. canWalk is an injected corridor-safety check.
-- Never bypass an unperformed Jump, and only consume a passed waypoint when the
-- player remains close to its original segment and can still walk back safely.
local function chooseRouteWaypoint(points, index, position, lastJumpIndex, canWalk, reanchor)
    local count = #points
    index = math.clamp(index or 2, 1, count + 1)
    for _ = 1, 12 do
        local wp = points[index]
        if not wp then break end
        local delta = wp.Position - position
        local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
        local jump = wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump
        local radius = index == count and 1 or 2.6
        local reached = flat.Magnitude <= radius and math.abs(delta.Y) < 7
            and (not jump or lastJumpIndex == index)
        local passed = false
        if not reached and wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk and index < count and flat.Magnitude <= 36 then
            local previous = points[index - 1]
            if previous then
                local segment = wp.Position - previous.Position
                segment = Vector3.new(segment.X, 0, segment.Z)
                local fromPrevious = position - previous.Position
                fromPrevious = Vector3.new(fromPrevious.X, 0, fromPrevious.Z)
                local lengthSquared = segment:Dot(segment)
                if lengthSquared > 0.01 then
                    local progress = fromPrevious:Dot(segment) / lengthSquared
                    local lateral = (fromPrevious - segment * progress).Magnitude
                    passed = progress >= 1 and lateral <= 2.8 and math.abs(delta.Y) < 7
                        and canWalk(wp.Position, 36)
                end
            end
        end
        if not reached and not passed then break end
        index += 1
    end
    local wp = points[index]
    if not wp or wp.Action ~= Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk then return index end
    if reanchor then
        -- A fresh async result may start behind a bend that the old route has
        -- already carried us around. Rejoin a nearby later walking segment;
        -- no jump/custom boundary may be crossed even during this handoff.
        local nearbyIndex = index
        for candidateIndex = index + 1, math.min(count, index + 15) do
            local candidate = points[candidateIndex]
            if candidate.Action ~= Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk then break end
            local delta = candidate.Position - position
            if Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude <= 14 and math.abs(delta.Y) < 7 then nearbyIndex = candidateIndex end
        end
        if nearbyIndex > index and canWalk(points[nearbyIndex].Position, 14) then index = nearbyIndex end
    end
    -- Look only a few ordinary waypoints ahead. The full corridor, including
    -- ground support, must be clear before cutting a gentle corner.
    local candidate = index
    for nextIndex = index + 1, math.min(count, index + 3) do
        local nextWaypoint = points[nextIndex]
        if nextWaypoint.Action ~= Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk then break end
        local delta = nextWaypoint.Position - position
        if Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude > 14 or math.abs(delta.Y) >= 7 then break end
        candidate = nextIndex
    end
    if candidate > index and canWalk(points[candidate].Position, 14) then return candidate end
    return index
end

-- This only validates a short walking shortcut; rejected segments keep the
-- original native path. Rays check body width/height and ground on both edges.
local function clearWalkSegment(c, target, from, destination, maximumDistance)
    local delta = destination - from
    local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then return false end
    if flat.Magnitude > (maximumDistance or 14) or math.abs(delta.Y) >= 7 then return false end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType, params.RespectCanCollide, params.IgnoreWater = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, true
    local excluded = {c}
    if target then table.insert(excluded, target) end
    local mobs = workspace:FindFirstChild("Mobs")
    if mobs then table.insert(excluded, mobs) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
    local side = Vector3.new(-flat.Z, 0, flat.X).Unit * 1.25
    for _, height in {-1.3, 0.5, 1.5} do
        for _, offset in {Vector3.zero, side, -side} do
            if workspace:Raycast(from + offset + Vector3.new(0, height, 0), flat, params) then return false end
        end
    end
    local humanoid = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local rootHeight = humanoid and rootPart and humanoid.HipHeight + rootPart.Size.Y / 2 or 3
    local expectedFloor, previousFloor = from.Y - rootHeight, nil
    local samples = math.max(1, math.ceil(flat.Magnitude / 2.5))
    for sample = 0, samples do
        local point = from + flat * (sample / samples)
        local floorY
        for _, offset in {Vector3.zero, side, -side} do
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(point + offset + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), params)
            if not hit or hit.Normal.Y < 0.65 or math.abs(hit.Position.Y - expectedFloor) > 5 then return false end
            if floorY and math.abs(hit.Position.Y - floorY) > 1.5 then return false end
            floorY = floorY or hit.Position.Y
        end
        if previousFloor and math.abs(floorY - previousFloor) > 2.3 then return false end
        previousFloor = floorY
    end
    -- A waypoint can lie on a different storey directly above the visible floor.
    -- Its own downward probe must agree with the floor reached along the segment.
    local destinationGround = workspace:Raycast(destination + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), params)
    if not destinationGround or destinationGround.Normal.Y < 0.65
        or math.abs(destinationGround.Position.Y - previousFloor) > 1.5 then return false end
    return true
end

local function planRoute(c, root, target)
    if planning or os.clock() - lastPlan < 1.5 then return end
    planning, lastPlan = true, os.clock()
    local ticket = generation
    local start = root.Position
    local finalDestination = mobRoot(target).Position
    local destination, partial = finalDestination, false
    local candidates = {{Position = destination, Partial = false}}
    local cave = state.Mode == "Mining" and inSteelCave(target)
    if state.Mode == "Mining" and target:GetAttribute("OreType") then
        candidates = oreApproaches(c, target, start)
        if cave then
            if (start - steelCaveEntry).Magnitude > 800 or start.Y > 260 then caveReached = 0 end
            if (start - steelCaveEntry).Magnitude < 25 then caveReached = math.max(caveReached, 1) end
            if (start - steelCaveFloor).Magnitude < 40 then caveReached = 2 end
            if (start - finalDestination).Magnitude > 650 or start.Y > 260 then
                candidates = {{Position = steelCaveEntry, Partial = true}}
            else
                if caveReached < 2 and (start - steelCaveFloor).Magnitude > 18 then
                    table.insert(candidates, {Position = steelCaveFloor, Partial = true})
                end
                if caveReached < 1 and (start - steelCaveEntry).Magnitude > 18 then
                    table.insert(candidates, {Position = steelCaveEntry, Partial = true})
                end
            end
            finalDestination = steelCaveEntry
            -- Medai's wall has a navmesh opening through a solid mesh. Leave through its real gate first.
            if not medaiExitCleared and (start - Vector3.new(-2450, 107, -735)).Magnitude < 420 then
                if start.X < -2670 then
                    medaiExitCleared = true
                else
                    if start.Z > -520 then medaiGateCleared = true end
                    local checkpoint = medaiGateCleared and medaiOutside or medaiExit
                    candidates = {{Position = checkpoint, Partial = true}}
                    finalDestination = checkpoint
                    if start.X < -2578 and start.Z > -825 and start.Z < -640 then
                        local params = RaycastParams.new()
                        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c}
                        params.RespectCanCollide = true
                        local escapes = start.Z > -740 and {Vector3.new(-2570, 107.28, -690)}
                            or {Vector3.new(-2570, 107.28, -797)}
                        for _, escape in escapes do
                            if (escape - start).Magnitude > 5 and (escape - start).Magnitude < 80
                                and not workspace:Raycast(start, escape - start, params) then
                                candidates = {{Position = escape, Partial = true, Direct = true}}
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #candidates == 0 then
        planning = false
        blocked[target] = os.clock() + 12
        state.Target = nil
        state.LastError = "ไม่มีพื้นที่ยืนขุดแร่"
        return
    end
    if (candidates[1].Position - start).Magnitude > 2200 then
        local intermediate = start + (candidates[1].Position - start).Unit * 450
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c, workspace.Mobs}
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(intermediate + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(0, -400, 0), params)
        candidates = {{Position = hit and hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) or intermediate, Partial = true}}
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        local path = Pathfinding:CreatePath({AgentRadius = cave and 2 or 3, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true, WaypointSpacing = cave and 8 or 6})
        local ok, problem
        local directRoute
        for _, candidate in candidates do
            if not state.Alive or not state.Enabled or ticket ~= generation then path:Destroy() return end
            destination, partial = candidate.Position, candidate.Partial
            if candidate.Direct then
                directRoute = {{Position = start, Action = Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk},
                    {Position = destination, Action = Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk}}
                ok = true
                break
            end
            ok, problem = pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(start, destination) end)
            if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then break end
        end
        -- Surface detours are only useful outside the cave; never choose its roof as a mining stance.
        if not directRoute and (not ok or path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success) and (not cave or (start - steelCaveEntry).Magnitude > 650) then
            local heading = Vector3.new(finalDestination.X - start.X, 0, finalDestination.Z - start.Z)
            if heading.Magnitude > 1 then
                heading = heading.Unit
                local params = RaycastParams.new()
                params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c, target}
                for _, sample in {{240, 0}, {240, 45}, {240, -45}, {180, 90}, {180, -90}, {90, 0}} do
                    if not state.Alive or not state.Enabled or ticket ~= generation then path:Destroy() return end
                    local angle = math.rad(sample[2])
                    local rotated = Vector3.new(heading.X * math.cos(angle) - heading.Z * math.sin(angle), 0,
                        heading.X * math.sin(angle) + heading.Z * math.cos(angle))
                    local candidate = start + rotated * sample[1]
                    local hit = workspace:Raycast(candidate + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(0, -400, 0), params)
                    if hit then candidate = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
                    ok, problem = pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(start, candidate) end)
                    if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                        destination, partial = candidate, true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if state.Alive and state.Enabled and ticket == generation then
            planning = false
            state.PathStatus = directRoute and "clear passage" or (ok and path.Status.Name or "error")
            if directRoute or (ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success) then
                local nextRoute = directRoute or path:GetWaypoints()
                local currentRoot = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not currentRoot or (currentRoot.Position - start).Magnitude > 72 then
                    -- Keep the previous path while replacing a result computed too far behind us.
                    lastPlan = -100
                    state.PathStatus = "Replan"
                    path:Destroy()
                    return
                end
                local nextIndex = chooseRouteWaypoint(nextRoute, 2, currentRoot.Position, nil, function(point, limit)
                    return clearWalkSegment(c, target, currentRoot.Position, point, limit)
                end, true)
                route, routeIndex, routeGoal, routeTarget, routeAt = nextRoute, nextIndex, destination, target, os.clock()
                routePartial = partial
                moveGoal = nextRoute[nextIndex] and nextRoute[nextIndex].Position or nil
                lastMove = -100
                state.NavStage = cave and (partial and "cave entrance" or "ore approach") or "target"
                state.RouteDestination = destination
                state.LastError = nil
                jumpedIndex = nil
            else
                state.LastError = not ok and tostring(problem) or "หาเส้นทางไม่พบ"
                blocked[target] = os.clock() + 18
                state.Target = nil
                stopMovement()
                state.Status = "กำลังหาเส้นทางอื่น"
            end
        end
        path:Destroy()
    end)
end

local function energyReady(c, h, root)
    local stamina = c:GetAttribute("Stamina")
    local maximum = c:GetAttribute("MaxStamina")
    if typeof(stamina) ~= "number" or typeof(maximum) ~= "number" or maximum <= 0 then return true end
    state.Stamina, state.MaxStamina = stamina, maximum
    if not state.StaminaRecovering and stamina <= maximum * 0.10 then
        state.StaminaRecovering = true
        state.StaminaStops += 1
        cancelAction()
        pcall(function() setSprint(false, true) end)
        if state.Mode == "Mining" then runAction("rest stamina", mining.Cancel) end
    end
    if state.StaminaRecovering then
        if stamina < maximum * 0.60 then
            stopMovement()
            lastProgress, lastPosition = os.clock(), root.Position
            state.Status = "พักฟื้นพลังงาน " .. math.floor(stamina) .. "/" .. math.floor(maximum) .. " • จะวิ่งต่อเอง"
            return false
        end
        state.StaminaRecovering = false
        state.StaminaResumes += 1
        lastProgress, lastPosition, lastMove = os.clock(), root.Position, -100
        if not valid(state.Target) or (mobRoot(state.Target).Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 8 then
            pcall(function() setSprint(true, true) end)
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function wallDetour(c, root, desired, objective)
    if desired.Magnitude < 1 then return end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c, workspace:FindFirstChild("Mobs")}
    params.RespectCanCollide = true
    local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, desired.Unit * math.min(8, desired.Magnitude + 2), params)
    if not hit or hit.Distance > 5 or math.abs(hit.Normal.Y) > 0.5 then return end
    local normal = Vector3.new(hit.Normal.X, 0, hit.Normal.Z)
    if normal.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
    normal = normal.Unit
    local tangent = Vector3.new(-normal.Z, 0, normal.X)
    local objectiveDirection = Vector3.new(objective.X - root.Position.X, 0, objective.Z - root.Position.Z)
    if objectiveDirection.Magnitude < 1 then objectiveDirection = desired end
    local best, score
    for _, direction in {tangent + normal * 0.4, -tangent + normal * 0.4, normal} do
        direction = direction.Unit
        local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * 11, params)
        local ground = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + direction * 9 + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), params)
        if not obstruction and ground and ground.Position.Y >= root.Position.Y - 8 and ground.Position.Y <= root.Position.Y + 3 then
            local value = direction:Dot(objectiveDirection.Unit)
            if not score or value > score then best, score = ground.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), value end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function navigate(c, h, root, target, distance, targetRoot)
    if not energyReady(c, h, root) then return end
    if state.Mode ~= "Mining" and target and target.Parent == workspace:FindFirstChild("Mobs") and distance <= 80 then
        local delta = targetRoot.Position-root.Position
        local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
        if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and math.abs(delta.Y)<6 then
            local params = RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType,params.FilterDescendantsInstances,params.RespectCanCollide = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude,{c,workspace.Mobs},true
            local side = Vector3.new(-flat.Z,0,flat.X).Unit*1.3
            local clear = true
            for _,offset in {Vector3.zero,side,-side} do
                if workspace:Raycast(root.Position+offset+Vector3.new(0,0.5,0),flat,params) then clear=false break end
            end
            if clear then
                local samples = math.max(1,math.ceil(flat.Magnitude/8))
                for i=1,samples do
                    local point = root.Position+flat*(i/samples)
                    local ground = workspace:Raycast(point+Vector3.new(0,2,0),Vector3.new(0,-10,0),params)
                    if not ground or ground.Normal.Y<0.5 or math.abs(ground.Position.Y-(root.Position.Y-3))>5 then clear=false break end
                end
            end
            if clear then
                if route or planning then invalidateRoute() end
                moveGoal = targetRoot.Position-flat.Unit*4.2
                local sprinting = c:GetAttribute("Sprinting") == true
                pcall(function()setSprint(flat.Magnitude > 18 or (sprinting and flat.Magnitude >= 10))end)
                state.PathStatus,state.Status = "Direct","กำลังเข้าหามอน"
                lastPosition,lastProgress = root.Position,os.clock()
                return
            end
        end
    end
    state.Status = planning and "กำลังคำนวณเส้นทาง" or "กำลังวิ่งหาเป้าหมาย"
    if avoidanceGoal then
        local remaining = Vector3.new(avoidanceGoal.X - root.Position.X, 0, avoidanceGoal.Z - root.Position.Z)
        if remaining.Magnitude > 2 and os.clock() < avoidanceUntil then
            moveGoal = avoidanceGoal
            pcall(function() setSprint(true) end)
            state.Status = "กำลังวิ่งอ้อมสิ่งกีดขวาง"
            lastProgress, lastPosition = os.clock(), root.Position
            return
        end
        invalidateRoute()
        lastProgress, lastPosition = os.clock(), root.Position
    end
    state.StepStage = "navigation"
    if not lastPosition or (root.Position - lastPosition).Magnitude >= 2 then
        lastPosition, lastProgress = root.Position, os.clock()
    elseif os.clock() - lastProgress > 5 then
        requestJump(h)
        invalidateRoute()
        lastProgress = os.clock()
    end
    if routeTarget ~= target or not route or routeIndex > #route then
        state.StepStage = "plan route"
        planRoute(c, root, target)
    elseif not routePartial and os.clock() - routeAt > 6 and routeGoal and (targetRoot.Position - routeGoal).Magnitude > 18 then
        -- Continue the current path until ComputeAsync has a fresh replacement.
        planRoute(c, root, target)
    end
    if route and routeIndex <= #route then
        state.StepStage = "follow route"
        local wp = route[routeIndex]
        local flat = Vector3.new(wp.Position.X - root.Position.X, 0, wp.Position.Z - root.Position.Z)
        if wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump and jumpedIndex ~= routeIndex and flat.Magnitude < 7 then
            if requestJump(h) then jumpedIndex = routeIndex end
        end
        routeIndex = chooseRouteWaypoint(route, routeIndex, root.Position, jumpedIndex, function(point, limit)
            return clearWalkSegment(c, target, root.Position, point, limit)
        end)
        wp = route[routeIndex]
        if wp then
            local desired = Vector3.new(wp.Position.X - root.Position.X, 0, wp.Position.Z - root.Position.Z)
            if os.clock() - lastMove > 0.2 then
                lastMove = os.clock()
                local detour = os.clock() - lastProgress > 1.5 and wp.Action ~= Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump
                    and wallDetour(c, root, desired, wp.Position)
                if detour then
                    avoidanceGoal, avoidanceUntil, moveGoal = detour, os.clock() + 3, detour
                    state.Detours = (state.Detours or 0) + 1
                    state.Status = "กำลังวิ่งอ้อมสิ่งกีดขวาง"
                    pcall(function() setSprint(true) end)
                    return
                end
            end
            if wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump and jumpedIndex ~= routeIndex and desired.Magnitude < 7 then
                if requestJump(h) then jumpedIndex = routeIndex end
            end
            -- The render steering loop owns Humanoid movement. Publish every step,
            -- even when the next waypoint changed during the old MoveTo throttle.
            moveGoal = wp.Position
            state.NavGoal = {X = wp.Position.X, Y = wp.Position.Y, Z = wp.Position.Z}
        else
            moveGoal = nil
            -- Finish one partial leg and request the next without the old 1.5 s idle.
            lastPlan = -100
            planRoute(c, root, target)
        end
    elseif distance < 16 then
        moveGoal = targetRoot.Position
    end
    pcall(function() setSprint(moveGoal ~= nil) end)
end

local function maybeWarpToOreTown(c, h, root, townTarget)
    if not state.AutoTownWarp or os.clock() < warpRetryAt then return false end
    if not warpPlan then
        local anchors = workspace:FindFirstChild("MapAnchors")
        local ores = workspace:FindFirstChild("OreNodes")
        if not anchors or (not ores and not townTarget) then return false end
        local nearestOre, bestDistance, bestAnchor = math.huge, math.huge, nil
        local nodes = townTarget and {townTarget} or ores:QueryDescendants("Model.OreNode")
        for _, node in nodes do
            if townTarget or valid(node) then nearestOre = math.min(nearestOre, ((townTarget and node.Position or oreTravelPoint(node)) - root.Position).Magnitude) end
        end
        if nearestOre < 900 then return false end
        for _, anchor in anchors:GetChildren() do
            if anchor:IsA("BasePart") then
                for _, node in nodes do
                    if townTarget or valid(node) then
                        local distance = ((townTarget and node.Position or oreTravelPoint(node)) - anchor.Position).Magnitude
                        if distance < bestDistance then bestDistance, bestAnchor = distance, anchor end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if not bestAnchor or (root.Position - bestAnchor.Position).Magnitude < 300 then return false end
        local ids = {["Town of Beginnings"] = "TOB", Medai = "Medai", Horunka = "Horunka", Tolbana = "Tolbana", Frosthaven = "Frosthaven", Eirholm = "Eirholm", Skalvik = "Skalvik"}
        local destinationId = ids[bestAnchor.Name]
        if not destinationId then return false end
        local nearestPrompt, sourceDistance = nil, math.huge
        for _, prompt in workspace:QueryDescendants("ProximityPrompt[$TeleportId]") do
            local part = prompt.Parent
            if prompt.Enabled and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < sourceDistance then nearestPrompt, sourceDistance = prompt, distance end
            end
        end
        if not nearestPrompt or nearestPrompt:GetAttribute("TeleportId") == destinationId
            or sourceDistance + bestDistance + 150 >= nearestOre then return false end
        warpPlan = {Prompt = nearestPrompt, Destination = destinationId, Anchor = bestAnchor, Stage = "travel"}
        state.Target = nil
        invalidateRoute()
        lastProgress, lastPosition = os.clock(), root.Position
    end
    if warpPlan.Stage == "waiting" then
        stopMovement()
        state.Status = "กำลังวาร์ปไป " .. warpPlan.Destination
        if (root.Position - warpPlan.Anchor.Position).Magnitude < 180 then
            state.Warps += 1
            state.LastWarpTown = warpPlan.Destination
            medaiExitCleared, medaiGateCleared = false, false
            caveReached = 0
            warpPlan = nil
            state.Target, lastPick = nil, -100
            invalidateRoute()
            return false
        elseif os.clock() - warpPlan.RequestedAt > 8 then
            warpPlan, warpRetryAt = nil, os.clock() + 60
            invalidateRoute()
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    local prompt = warpPlan.Prompt
    if not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then warpPlan = nil return false end
    local part = prompt.Parent
    if (blocked[part] or 0) > os.clock() then
        warpPlan, warpRetryAt = nil, os.clock() + 60
        invalidateRoute()
        return false
    end
    local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
    state.Distance = distance
    if distance <= math.max(4, prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 1) then
        stopMovement()
        pcall(function() setSprint(false) end)
        if not actionBusy() then
            local id = warpPlan.Destination
            warpPlan.Stage, warpPlan.RequestedAt = "waiting", os.clock()
            runAction("town teleport", function() mining.WarpTown(id) end)
        end
    else
        navigate(c, h, root, part, distance, part)
        if not state.StaminaRecovering then state.Status = "ไปจุดวาร์ป → " .. warpPlan.Destination end
    end
    return true
end

local function stepForgeQuest(c, h, root)
    local snapshot = forgeQuest.Snapshot()
    state.QuestPhase, state.QuestRemaining = snapshot.Phase, snapshot.Remaining or 0
    state.QuestHave, state.QuestNeed = snapshot.Have, snapshot.Need
    state.QuestGuardRemaining = snapshot.GuardRemaining
    state.Status = snapshot.Status
    if snapshot.Phase == "Scene" then
        cancelAction()
        stopMovement()
        pcall(function()setSprint(false)end)
        if snapshot.OwnScene then forgeQuest.Choose() end
        return false
    end
    if snapshot.Phase == "Cooldown" or snapshot.Phase == "Locked" or snapshot.Phase == "OtherQuest"
        or snapshot.Phase == "Unavailable" or snapshot.Phase == "Finishing" then
        state.Target = nil
        stopMovement()
        pcall(function()setSprint(false)end)
        return false
    end
    if combat.IsFocused() then state.Status = "พัก • ปิดหน้าต่างเกมเพื่อทำเควสต่อ" stopMovement() return false end
    local marker = snapshot.Marker
    if not marker then return false end
    local delta = marker.Position - root.Position
    if snapshot.Phase == "Defend" then
        state.QuestSawActive = true
        local guard = forgeQuest.GuardRoot() or marker
        delta = guard.Position - root.Position
        -- Stay close to the objective even after getting knocked away.
        if Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude > 40 or math.abs(delta.Y) > 16 then
            state.Target = nil
            navigate(c,h,root,guard,delta.Magnitude,guard)
            state.Status = "กลับไปป้องกันโรงตีเหล็ก"
            return false
        end
        local best = chooseTarget(root)
        if best and best ~= state.Target then
            local current = state.Target
            local currentRoot = current and mobRoot(current)
            local bestRoot = mobRoot(best)
            if not currentRoot or (bestRoot.Position-guard.Position).Magnitude + 8 < (currentRoot.Position-guard.Position).Magnitude then
                state.Target = nil
                invalidateRoute()
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    if snapshot.Phase == "Available" and delta.Magnitude < 90 and chooseTarget(root) then
        state.Status = "เคลียร์ศัตรูใกล้โรงตีเหล็กก่อนรับเควส"
        state.QuestPhase = "Prepare"
        return true
    end
    state.Target = nil
    if maybeWarpToOreTown(c,h,root,marker) then return false end
    if delta.Magnitude > 10 then
        navigate(c,h,root,marker,delta.Magnitude,marker)
        state.Status, state.Distance = "ไปหา Blacksmither • " .. math.floor(delta.Magnitude) .. " studs", delta.Magnitude
        return false
    end
    stopMovement()
    pcall(function()setSprint(false)end)
    local sent, problem = forgeQuest.Request(snapshot.Phase == "Available" and "mission" or "talk",root,marker)
    if sent == nil then state.SetEnabled(false) state.Status = problem end
    return false
end


local function stepMining(c, h, root)
    local item, tier = mining.Pickaxe()
    if not item or tier < mining.RequiredTier(state.Selected) then
        state.SetEnabled(false)
        state.Status = "ต้องมี Pickaxe ที่ขุดแร่ชนิดนี้ได้"
        return
    end
    state.OreGained = math.max(0, mining.Count(state.Selected) - (miningBaseline or mining.Count(state.Selected)))
    state.SteelGained = math.max(0, mining.Count("SteelOre") - (steelBaseline or mining.Count("SteelOre")))
    state.IronGained = math.max(0, mining.Count("IronOre") - (ironBaseline or mining.Count("IronOre")))
    state.CrystalliteGained = math.max(0, mining.Count("CrystalliteOre") - (crystalliteBaseline or mining.Count("CrystalliteOre")))
    if not energyReady(c, h, root) then return end
    if maybeWarpToOreTown(c, h, root) then return end
    if not mining.Equipped() then
        stopMovement()
        state.Status = "กำลังเปลี่ยนเป็น Pickaxe"
        if os.clock() - lastEquip > 2 and not actionBusy() then
            lastEquip = os.clock()
            runAction("equip pickaxe", mining.Equip)
        end
        return
    end
    if not mining.Ready() then
        stopMovement()
        state.Status = "กำลังถือ Pickaxe"
        if os.clock() - lastEquip > 1.5 and not actionBusy() then
            lastEquip = os.clock()
            runAction("draw pickaxe", mining.Draw)
        end
        return
    end
    local target = state.Target
    if not valid(target) then
        local previousKind = target and target:GetAttribute("OreType")
        if target and engaged[target] and target:GetAttribute("MinedOut") then
            state.NodesMined += 1
            if state.Selected == "CaveSteelFirst" then
                if target:GetAttribute("OreType") == "SteelOre" then
                    -- Finish this set of Steel nodes before revisiting a fast respawn, so Iron gets a turn.
                    steelRound[target.Name] = true
                else
                    table.clear(steelRound)
                end
            end
        end
        if target then engaged[target] = nil end
        state.Target = nil
        if os.clock() - lastPick < 0.18 then return end
        lastPick = os.clock()
        target = chooseTarget(root)
        if state.Selected == "CaveSteelFirst" and previousKind == "IronOre" and target
            and target:GetAttribute("OreType") == "SteelOre" then state.PrioritySwitches += 1 end
        state.Target = target
        invalidateRoute()
        if target then
            local nextRoot = mobRoot(target)
            local delta = nextRoot.Position - root.Position
            local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude > 7.1 and flat.Magnitude < 20 and math.abs(delta.Y) < 7 then
                local approach = Vector3.new(nextRoot.Position.X, root.Position.Y, nextRoot.Position.Z) - flat.Unit * 6
                if clearWalkSegment(c, target, root.Position, approach, 14) then moveGoal = approach end
            end
        end
        lastPosition, lastProgress = root.Position, os.clock()
    end
    if not target then
        stopMovement()
        pcall(function() setSprint(false) end)
        state.Status, state.Distance = currentFloor == 2 and "รอ Crystallite ในเขตที่เลือกเกิดใหม่" or "รอแร่ในถ้ำเกิดใหม่", 0
        return
    end
    local targetRoot = mobRoot(target)
    local delta = targetRoot.Position - root.Position
    local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
    if mineAimTarget ~= target then mineAimTarget, mineAimSince = target, os.clock() end
    state.Distance = delta.Magnitude
    if flat.Magnitude <= 7.1 and math.abs(delta.Y) <= 7 then
        -- Finish a short, checked reposition before exact aiming again.
        -- Otherwise the old stop/lookAt every tick fights the walking turn.
        if mineRepositionTarget == target and mineRepositionGoal and os.clock() < (mineRepositionUntil or 0) then
            local remaining = mineRepositionGoal - root.Position
            if Vector3.new(remaining.X,0,remaining.Z).Magnitude > 1.25 then
                moveGoal = mineRepositionGoal
                state.Status = "กำลังจัดตำแหน่งขุดแร่"
                pcall(function()setSprint(false)end)
                lastProgress,lastPosition = os.clock(),root.Position
                return
            end
        end
        mineRepositionGoal,mineRepositionTarget,mineRepositionUntil = nil,nil,nil
        stopMovement()
        route = nil
        h.AutoRotate = false
        pcall(function() setSprint(false) end)
        if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 then root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flat) end
        state.Status = "กำลังขุดแร่"
        local aimed = mining.FindOre()
        if aimed == target then
            mineAimSince = os.clock()
        elseif os.clock() - (mineAimSince or os.clock()) > 4 then
            blocked[target] = os.clock() + 8
            state.Target = nil
            invalidateRoute()
            stopMovement()
            mineAimTarget, mineAimSince = nil, nil
            state.Status = "กำลังหาตำแหน่งขุดใหม่"
            return
        end
        if aimed == target and not actionBusy() and os.clock() - lastAttack >= 0.25 then
            lastAttack = os.clock()
            runAction("mine ore", function()
                if state.Alive and state.Enabled and state.Mode == "Mining" and state.Target == target and valid(target) then
                    if mining.Swing(target) then
                        state.MiningSwings += 1
                        engaged[target] = true
                    end
                end
            end)
        elseif aimed and aimed ~= target and valid(aimed)
            and not engaged[target] and not actionBusy() and not mining.IsSwinging()
            and aimed:GetAttribute("OreType") == target:GetAttribute("OreType")
            and (state.Selected ~= "CaveSteelFirst" or not steelRound[aimed.Name] or steelRound[target.Name]) then
            state.Target = aimed
            invalidateRoute()
        elseif aimed and aimed ~= target then
            local other = mobRoot(aimed)
            local away = other and targetRoot.Position - other.Position or -delta
            away = Vector3.new(away.X, 0, away.Z)
            if away.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                local position = targetRoot.Position + away.Unit * 4.5
                if clearWalkSegment(c,nil,root.Position,position,14) then
                    mineRepositionGoal,mineRepositionTarget,mineRepositionUntil = position,target,os.clock()+2
                    moveGoal = position
                    state.Status = "กำลังจัดตำแหน่งขุดแร่"
                end
            end
        end
        lastProgress, lastPosition = os.clock(), root.Position
    else
        mineAimSince = os.clock()
        navigate(c, h, root, target, state.Distance, targetRoot)
    end
end

local function step()
    state.StepStage = "begin"
    stepFreeRespawn()
    if potionController then
        local potionOk,potionProblem = pcall(potionController.Step)
        if not potionOk then
            state.PotionError,state.PotionStatus = tostring(potionProblem),"รอระบบยาพร้อม • ลองปิดเปิดยาอัตโนมัติ"
        end
    end
    if state.Selling then reconcileSale() end
    if state.Respawning then
        state.Status, state.Target, state.Distance = state.RespawnStatus, nil, 0
        return
    end
    if state.Travelling then
        travelController.Step(state.TravelJob)
        if state.TravelJob then state.TravelDistance = state.TravelJob.Distance end
        return
    end
    if not state.Enabled then return end
    local c, h, root = character()
    if not c then
        state.Status = "รอเกิดใหม่"
        state.Target, state.Distance = nil, 0
        return
    end
    if potionController and potionController.Pending then
        pcall(combat.Release)
        stopMovement()
        pcall(function()setSprint(false)end)
        state.Status = state.PotionStatus
        return
    end
    remember(c, h)
    if autoSkills.Busy() then
        state.Status = "กำลังใช้สกิล " .. (state.LastSkill or "")
        return
    end
    if state.Mode == "Quest" and not stepForgeQuest(c,h,root) then return end
    if actionBusy() and os.clock() - actionAt > 8 then
        state.LastError = "คำสั่งต่อสู้ไม่ตอบสนอง: " .. tostring(state.ActionStage)
        state.SetEnabled(false)
        state.Status = "หยุด: ระบบต่อสู้ไม่ตอบสนอง"
        return
    end
    if combat.IsFocused() then
        stopMovement()
        pcall(function() setSprint(false, true) end)
        state.Status = "พักระหว่างเปิดหน้าต่างของเกม"
        return
    end
    if controls and controls.controlsEnabled ~= false then
        pcall(function() controls:Disable() controlsChanged = true end)
    end
    if state.Mode == "Mining" then
        stepMining(c, h, root)
        return
    end
    local target = state.Target
    if target and engaged[target] then
        local health = target:GetAttribute("Health")
        if typeof(health) == "number" then
            local record = engaged[target]
            if health < record.Lowest then
                state.DamageObserved += record.Lowest - health
                record.Lowest = health
            end
        end
    end
    if not valid(target) then
        pcall(combat.Release)
        stopMovement()
        if target and engaged[target] and (target:GetAttribute("IsDead") or (target:GetAttribute("Health") or 0) <= 0) then
            state.Kills += 1
            engaged[target] = nil
        end
        state.Target = nil
        if os.clock() - lastPick < 0.6 then return end
        lastPick = os.clock()
        target = chooseTarget(root)
        state.Target = target
        invalidateRoute()
        lastPosition, lastProgress = root.Position, os.clock()
    end
    if not target then
        pcall(combat.Release)
        stopMovement()
        state.Status, state.Distance = state.Mode == "Quest" and "เฝ้าโรงตีเหล็ก • รอมอนระลอกถัดไป" or "รอมอนสเตอร์ชนิดที่เลือกเกิด", 0
        return
    end
    local targetRoot = mobRoot(target)
    state.StepStage = "prepare weapon"
    if c:GetAttribute("Sheathed") and os.clock() - lastEquip > 1.5 and not actionBusy() then
        lastEquip = os.clock()
        runAction("draw weapon", combat.Unsheathe)
    end
    local delta = targetRoot.Position - root.Position
    local distance = delta.Magnitude
    local flatDistance = Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude
    state.Distance = distance
    if not c:GetAttribute("Sheathed") and distance <= 13 and not actionBusy() then
        local row = autoSkills.Next()
        if row then
            if not engaged[target] then engaged[target] = {Lowest = target:GetAttribute("Health")} end
            pcall(combat.Release)
            stopMovement()
            pcall(function()setSprint(false)end)
            runAction("skill "..row.Name,function()autoSkills.Cast(row,target)end)
            return
        end
    end
    local reach = state.CombatRangeTarget == target and 7.5 or 6.2
    if flatDistance <= reach and math.abs(delta.Y) <= 7 then
        state.CombatRangeTarget = target
        route = nil
        moveGoal = nil
        h:MoveTo(root.Position)
        pcall(function() setSprint(false) end)
        h.AutoRotate = false
        local direction = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
        if direction.Magnitude > 0.1 then root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + direction) end
        state.Status = "กำลังโจมตี"
        if c:GetAttribute("Sheathed") then
            if os.clock() - lastEquip > 1.5 then
                lastEquip = os.clock()
                runAction("draw weapon", combat.Unsheathe)
            end
        elseif os.clock() - lastAttack >= 0.20 and not actionBusy() then
            lastAttack = os.clock()
            if not engaged[target] then engaged[target] = {Lowest = target:GetAttribute("Health")} end
            state.Attacks += 1
            runAction("attack", combat.Attack)
        end
        lastProgress, lastPosition = os.clock(), root.Position
        return
    end
    state.CombatRangeTarget = nil
    pcall(combat.Release)
    navigate(c, h, root, target, distance, targetRoot)
end

combat = resolveCombat()
mining = resolveMining()
crafting = resolveCrafting()
selling = resolveSelling()
freeRespawn = resolveFreeRespawn()
serviceTravel = resolveServiceTravel()
forgeQuest = resolveForgeQuest()
autoSkills = resolveAutoSkills()
autoPotion = resolveAutoPotion()
potionController = createAutoPotionController(autoPotion, {
    State = state,
    BeforeRequest = function()
        local setIdentity = setthreadidentity or setidentity
        if setIdentity then setIdentity(2) end
    end,
})
travelController = createServiceTravelController(serviceTravel, {
    OnStatus = function(job, message)
        if state.TravelJob == job then state.TravelStatus = message end
    end,
    OnFinish = function(job)
        if state.TravelJob ~= job then return end
        state.Travelling, state.TravelStatus, state.TravelDistance = false, job.Status, job.Distance
        if job.Kind == "Craft" then state.CraftStatus = job.Status else state.SellStatus = job.Status end
        if not job.Arrived then state.SellConfirmation = nil end
        queueStatus()
    end,
})
respawnController = createFreeRespawnController(freeRespawn, {
    Enabled = state.AutoRespawn, Deaths = state.RespawnDeaths, Requests = state.RespawnRequests, Completed = state.Respawns,
    OnDeath = function()
        if state.Travelling then state.CancelServiceTravel("ตายระหว่างเดิน • ยกเลิกรายการที่รอแล้ว") end
        cancelAction()
        stopMovement()
        invalidateRoute()
        state.Target, state.Distance, state.StaminaRecovering = nil, 0, false
        state.SellConfirmation = nil
        if state.Crafting then state.CancelCraft() end
        if state.Selling then state.CancelSale() end
        warpPlan, mineAimTarget, mineAimSince = nil, nil, nil
    end,
    OnReady = function()
        state.Target, state.Distance, state.StaminaRecovering = nil, 0, false
        medaiExitCleared, medaiGateCleared, caveReached = false, false, 0
        warpPlan, mineAimTarget, mineAimSince = nil, nil, nil
        table.clear(blocked)
        table.clear(engaged)
        table.clear(steelRound)
        invalidateRoute()
        lastPosition, lastProgress = nil, os.clock()
        lastAttack, lastEquip, lastPick, lastPlan = -100, -100, -100, -100
        state.Status = state.Enabled and "เกิดใหม่แล้ว • กำลังกลับไปฟาร์มต่อ" or "เกิดใหม่แล้ว • พร้อมใช้งาน"
    end,
})
saleRunner = createSellBatchRunner(selling, {
    Locks = state.SellLocks,
    BeforeRequest = function()
        local setIdentity = setthreadidentity or setidentity
        if setIdentity then setIdentity(2) end
    end,
    OnStatus = function(job, message)
        if state.SellBatch == job then state.SellStatus = message end
    end,
    OnCommit = function(job, receipt)
        if state.SellBatch ~= job then return end
        state.SoldCount += 1
        state.SaleCol += receipt.Price
        state.LastSale = {Id = receipt.Id, Name = receipt.Name, Price = receipt.Price, Confirmed = true}
        state.SellSelection[receipt.Id], state.SellLocks[receipt.Id] = nil, nil
        if state.SelectedSellId == receipt.Id then state.SelectedSellId, state.Selected = "", "" end
        refreshChoices()
    end,
    OnFinish = function(job)
        if state.SellBatch ~= job then return end
        state.Selling, state.SellReceipt, state.SellRequestPending, state.SellThread = false, nil, false, nil
        state.SellStatus = job.Status
        refreshChoices()
        queueStatus()
    end,
})
if not table.find(crafting.Types, state.SelectedWeapon) then state.SelectedWeapon = crafting.Types[1] end
if not table.find(crafting.Materials, state.CraftMaterial) then state.CraftMaterial = crafting.Materials[1] end
if state.Mode == "Craft" then state.Selected = state.SelectedWeapon end
if state.Mode == "Sell" then state.Selected = state.SelectedSellId end
for _, candidate in filtergc("table", {Keys = {"moveFunction", "controlsEnabled"}}, false) do
    if typeof(candidate.moveFunction) == "function" and typeof(candidate.Enable) == "function" and candidate.activeController then
        controls = candidate
        break
    end
end
if not controls then
    pcall(function()
        local module = player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
        if module then controls = require(module):GetControls() end
    end)
end
state.HasControls = controls ~= nil
createGui()
state.AntiAfkConnection = continuity.IdleSession.Connection
state.WebhookThread = task.spawn(function()
    local setIdentity = setthreadidentity or setidentity
    if setIdentity then setIdentity(8) end
    while state.Alive do
        local ok = pcall(webhookStep)
        if not ok then state.WebhookStatus = "ระบบแจ้งเตือนขัดข้อง • ลองปิด/เปิดแจ้งเตือน" end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)
connect(player.CharacterAdded, function()
    motionController.Release()
    if state.Travelling then state.CancelServiceTravel("เกิดตัวละครใหม่ • ยกเลิกรายการที่รอแล้ว") end
    cancelAction()
    if not state.Selling then state.SellConfirmation = nil end
    if state.Crafting then state.CancelCraft() end
    medaiExitCleared, medaiGateCleared = false, false
    caveReached = 0
    state.Target = nil
    invalidateRoute()
    lastPosition, lastProgress = nil, os.clock()
    if state.Enabled and controls and controls.controlsEnabled ~= false then
        pcall(function() controls:Disable() controlsChanged = true end)
    end
end)
state.StepThread = task.spawn(function()
    while state.Alive do
        local ok, problem = pcall(step)
        if not ok then
            state.LastError = tostring(problem)
            if state.Travelling then state.CancelServiceTravel("เดินขัดข้อง • ยังไม่ได้ทำรายการ") end
            state.SetEnabled(false)
            state.Status = "หยุดเพราะข้อผิดพลาด"
        end
        state.StepStage = "update labels"
        queueStatus()
        state.StepStage = "waiting"
        task.wait(0.12)
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    while state.Alive do
        task.wait(3)
        if state.Alive then pcall(refreshChoices) end
    end
end)


-- Restore the farm switch only after all native adapters and UI are available.
continuity.Queue()
connect(player.OnTeleport,function(teleportState)
    if teleportState==Enum.TeleportState.Started or teleportState==Enum.TeleportState.InProgress
        or teleportState==Enum.TeleportState.WaitingForServer then
        state.FloorTeleportStarted=true
        continuity.Save(state,true)
        continuity.Queue()
    end
end)
connect(game:GetService("TeleportService").TeleportInitFailed,function(who)
    if who==player then worldController.TravelFailed("ย้ายชั้นไม่สำเร็จ • ลองใหม่ได้") end
end)
state.ShowMenu(previousSettings.MenuVisible~=false)
state.AutoResumePending=continuity.Store.CanResume(previousSettings,state.Mode)
if state.AutoResumePending then state.FloorTravelResumeEnabled=true end
state.PersistenceThread=task.spawn(function()
    while state.Alive do
        local ok=pcall(continuity.Save,state,false)
        if not ok then state.PersistenceStatus="บันทึกขัดข้อง • จะลองใหม่" end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local deadline=os.clock()+15
    while state.Alive and state.AutoResumePending and state.AutoResumeFarm and os.clock()<deadline do
        local c=player.Character
        local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if h and h.Health>0 and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and not state.RestoringEquipment then
            state.SetEnabled(true)
            if state.Enabled then break end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
    state.AutoResumePending=false
    if not state.FloorTravelling then state.FloorTravelResumeEnabled=nil end
    if state.Alive then continuity.Save(state,true) end
end)

local installed,installError=pcall(function()
    if type(writefile)~="function" then return end
    if type(makefolder)=="function" then pcall(makefolder,"EvernightControl") end
    writefile("EvernightControl/main.luau",source)
    if type(readfile)=="function" and readfile("EvernightControl/main.luau")~=source then error("Source verification failed") end
end)
local chunk,problem=loadstring(source)
if not chunk then getgenv().EvernightContinuityInit={Ok=false,Error=problem};return end
local ok,result=xpcall(chunk,debug.traceback)
getgenv().EvernightContinuityInit={Ok=ok,Installed=installed,Error=not ok and tostring(result) or not installed and tostring(installError) or nil}
return ok and result or nil
